    18	/-- Taking the square root of the Pauli error is bounded by halving its
    19	exponent. This formalization-only scalar estimate supports the passage from
    20	the squared extraction bound to the norm bound in blueprint
    21	`rem:pauli-robustness-form`; it is stated as `thm:pauli-error-square-root-support`.
    22	It holds for all nonnegative errors. -/
    23	theorem sqrt_deltaQld_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {a b epsilon : ℝ}
    24	    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) :
    25	    Real.sqrt (deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q) ≤
    26	      deltaQld a (b / 2) epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
    27	  let degree : ℝ := ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ)
    28	  have hdegree : 1 ≤ degree :=
    29	    Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.mul_pos P.one_le_m P.hd)
    30	  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := zero_le_one.trans ha
    31	  have hdegree0 : 0 ≤ degree := zero_le_one.trans hdegree
    32	  have hprefactor : 1 ≤ a * degree ^ a :=
    33	    one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le ha (Real.one_le_rpow hdegree ha0)
    34	  have hq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ P.q := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    35	  have htwo : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by norm_num
    36	  have hroot_sum {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    37	      (x + y + z) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
    38	        x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    39	    (Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow (add_nonneg hx hy) hz (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).trans
    40	      (add_le_add (Real.rpow_add_le_add_rpow hx hy (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) le_rfl)
    41	  have hrate :
    42	      (epsilon ^ b + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-b) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(b * degree))) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
    43	        epsilon ^ (b / 2) + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-(b / 2)) +
    44	          (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((b / 2) * degree)) := by
    45	    have h := hroot_sum (Real.rpow_nonneg hepsilon b) (Real.rpow_nonneg hq (-b))
    46	      (Real.rpow_nonneg htwo (-(b * degree)))
    47	    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hepsilon, ← Real.rpow_mul hq, ← Real.rpow_mul htwo] at h
    48	    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, neg_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using h
    49	  unfold deltaQld
    50	  simp only [Real.rpow_eq_pow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    51	  change (a * degree ^ a *
    52	      (epsilon ^ b + (P.q : ℝ) ^ (-b) + (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(b * degree)))) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ _
    53	  rw [Real.mul_rpow (zero_le_one.trans hprefactor) (by positivity)]
    54	  exact mul_le_mul
    55	    (Real.rpow_le_self_of_one_le hprefactor (by norm_num)) hrate
    56	    (by positivity) (zero_le_one.trans hprefactor)

    29	/-- The completed point-pair effect is bounded by the effect of its linear
    30	combination at the actual combined evaluation. Undefined source evaluations
    31	contribute zero on the point side. The statement holds for either player's
    32	measurement without any symmetry assumption on the strategy or local spaces. -/
    33	theorem SubLineWitness.completedPoint_effect_le {params : AdmissibleParams}
    34	    {Carrier : Type*} [Fintype Carrier] [DecidableEq Carrier]
    35	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (sample : SubLineTriple params)
    36	    (hsample : sample ∈ sublines.D.support)
    37	    (polynomials : DegPoly params.toLdParams (params.m * params.d) ×
    38	      DegPoly params.toLdParams (params.m * params.d))
    39	    (point : Fin params.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)
    40	    (hpoint : point ∈ sample.1.pointSet)
    41	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement (PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params) Carrier) :
    42	    (measurement.postprocess (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).effect
    43	      (evalOpt sample.2.1 (projX (directPointToPauli params point)) polynomials.1,
    44	        evalOpt sample.2.2 (projZ (directPointToPauli params point)) polynomials.2) ≤
    45	      (measurement.postprocess (fun pair => some
    46	        ((directPointToPauli params point) (alphaVar params.m) * pair.1 +
    47	          (directPointToPauli params point) (betaVar params.m) * pair.2))).effect
    48	        ((directEvalOpt sample.1 point
    49	          (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample hsample polynomials)).map
    50	            (extendedDirectScalarEquiv params)) := by
    51	  classical
    52	  have hnoneX (value : Option (PauliScalar params)) :
    53	      (measurement.postprocess (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).effect (none, value) =
    54	        0 := by
    55	    rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    56	    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    57	    intro pair hpair
    58	    have himpossible := congrArg Prod.fst (Finset.mem_filter.mp hpair).2
    59	    simp at himpossible
    60	  have hnoneZ (value : Option (PauliScalar params)) :
    61	      (measurement.postprocess (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).effect (value, none) =
    62	        0 := by
    63	    rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    64	    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    65	    intro pair hpair
    66	    have himpossible := congrArg Prod.snd (Finset.mem_filter.mp hpair).2
    67	    simp at himpossible
    68	  cases hevalX : evalOpt sample.2.1 (projX (directPointToPauli params point)) polynomials.1 with
    69	  | none =>
    70	    erw [hnoneX]
    71	    exact Quantum.Submeasurement.pos _ _
    72	  | some valueX =>
    73	    cases hevalZ : evalOpt sample.2.2 (projZ (directPointToPauli params point)) polynomials.2 with
    74	    | none =>
    75	      erw [hnoneZ]
    76	      exact Quantum.Submeasurement.pos _ _
    77	    | some valueZ =>
    78	      rw [sublines.combinedPolynomial_evalOpt sample hsample polynomials point hpoint
    79	        valueX valueZ hevalX hevalZ]
    80	      have hinjective : Function.Injective
    81	          (fun pair : PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params => (some pair.1, some pair.2)) := by
    82	        intro left right hequal
    83	        exact Prod.ext (Option.some.inj (congrArg Prod.fst hequal))
    84	          (Option.some.inj (congrArg Prod.snd hequal))
    85	      erw [SandwichProduct.postprocess_effect_of_injective measurement _ hinjective
    86	        (valueX, valueZ)]
    87	      rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    88	      exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun pair _ => measurement.pos pair)
    89	        (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)

   141	    (operator : Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace placement.side)) :

   147	/-- A placed overlap is linear in an averaged left operator. -/
   148	private theorem placed_overlap_average {params : AdmissibleParams} {error : ℝ}
   149	    {Sample : Type*} (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (first second : Placement)
   150	    (law : Distribution Sample) (family : Sample → Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side))
   151	    (right : Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side)) :
   152	    stateQForm setting.psiHat
   153	      (setting.place first (averageOperatorOverDistribution law family) *
   154	        setting.place second right) =
   155	      avgOver law (fun sample => stateQForm setting.psiHat
   156	        (setting.place first (family sample) * setting.place second right)) := by
   157	  unfold averageOperatorOverDistribution avgOver
   158	  rw [setting.place_finsetSum, Finset.sum_mul, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   159	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   160	  intro sample _
   161	  rw [place_real_smul, smul_mul_assoc]
   162	  have hscalar (operator : Op (SixReg params setting.toStrategy.ιA setting.toStrategy.ιB)) :
   163	      law.weight sample • operator = (law.weight sample : ℂ) • operator := by
   164	    ext row column
   165	    simp [Complex.real_smul]
   166	  rw [hscalar]
   167	  simp only [stateQForm, WinImplications.applyOperatorToState_smul_op, inner_smul_right,
   168	    Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]

   170	/-- Postprocessing the left measurement groups, but does not alter, its overlap
   171	with a family indexed by the postprocessed answer. -/
   172	private theorem placed_overlap_postprocess {params : AdmissibleParams} {error : ℝ}
   173	    {Answer Output : Type*} [Fintype Answer] [DecidableEq Answer]
   174	    [Fintype Output] [DecidableEq Output]
   175	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (first second : Placement)
   176	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement Answer (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side))
   177	    (mapping : Answer → Output) (right : Output → Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side)) :
   178	    (∑ output, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   179	      (setting.place first ((measurement.postprocess mapping).effect output) *
   180	        setting.place second (right output))) =
   181	      ∑ answer, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   182	        (setting.place first (measurement.effect answer) *
   183	          setting.place second (right (mapping answer))) := by
   184	  classical
   185	  simp only [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, setting.place_finsetSum,
   186	    Finset.sum_mul, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   187	  calc
   188	    (∑ output, ∑ answer ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun answer => mapping answer = output),
   189	        stateQForm setting.psiHat (setting.place first (measurement.effect answer) *
   190	          setting.place second (right output))) =
   191	        ∑ output, ∑ answer ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun answer => mapping answer = output),
   192	          stateQForm setting.psiHat (setting.place first (measurement.effect answer) *
   193	            setting.place second (right (mapping answer))) := by
   194	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   195	      intro output _
   196	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   197	      intro answer hanswer
   198	      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hanswer).2]
   199	    _ = _ := Finset.sum_fiberwise _ _ _

   201	/-- On opposite registers a positive left effect preserves order in the right
   202	effect. This applies to both directed player placements without exchanging spaces. -/
   203	private theorem placed_overlap_mono {params : AdmissibleParams} {error : ℝ}
   204	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (first second : Placement)
   205	    (hopposite : first.IsOpposite second)
   206	    (left : Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side))
   207	    (lower upper : Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side))
   208	    (hleft : 0 ≤ left) (hright : lower ≤ upper) :
   209	    stateQForm setting.psiHat (setting.place first left * setting.place second lower) ≤
   210	      stateQForm setting.psiHat (setting.place first left * setting.place second upper) := by
   211	  have hpositive := setting.place_mul_place_nonneg first second hopposite hleft
   212	    (sub_nonneg.mpr hright)
   213	  rw [setting.place_sub, mul_sub] at hpositive
   214	  exact quadratic_form_mono (sub_nonneg.mp hpositive) setting.psiHat

   216	/-- Expand the actual conditional extended-line POVM in a placed overlap.
   217	This is exactly the averaging step at paper lines 1118--1134. -/
   218	theorem SubLineWitness.extendedMeasurement_overlap {params : AdmissibleParams}
   219	    {error pointError lineError : ℝ} {setting : ProjectiveSetting params error}
   220	    {points : CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError}
   221	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError)
   222	    (first second : Placement) (line : DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd)
   223	    (point : Fin params.extendedDirectLd.m → DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)
   224	    (right : Option (PauliScalar params) → Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side)) :
   225	    (∑ answer, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   226	      (setting.place first (((sublines.extendedMeasurement lines first.side line).postprocess
   227	        (fun polynomial => (directEvalOpt line point polynomial).map
   228	          (extendedDirectScalarEquiv params))).effect answer) *
   229	            setting.place second (right answer))) =
   230	      avgOver (sublines.conditionalLaw line) (fun sample =>
   231	        ∑ pair, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   232	          (setting.place first ((lines.T first.side sample.val.2.1 sample.val.2.2).effect pair) *
   233	            setting.place second (right ((directEvalOpt line point
   234	              (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample.val
   235	                (Finset.mem_filter.mp sample.property).1 pair)).map
   236	                  (extendedDirectScalarEquiv params))))) := by
   237	  rw [placed_overlap_postprocess]
   238	  change (∑ polynomial, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   239	    (setting.place first (averageOperatorOverDistribution (sublines.conditionalLaw line)
   240	      (fun sample => ((lines.T first.side sample.val.2.1 sample.val.2.2).postprocess
   241	        (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample.val
   242	          (Finset.mem_filter.mp sample.property).1)).effect polynomial)) *
   243	      setting.place second (right ((directEvalOpt line point polynomial).map
   244	        (extendedDirectScalarEquiv params))))) = _
   245	  simp_rw [placed_overlap_average]
   246	  rw [← avgOver_sum]
   247	  apply avgOver_congr
   248	  intro sample
   249	  exact placed_overlap_postprocess setting first second _ _ _

   270	    (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError) (sublines : SubLineWitness params)

   284	/-- The completed point-effect comparison survives conditional averaging and
   285	placement on either directed opposite register pair. -/
   286	theorem SubLineWitness.extendedPointOverlap_ge {params : AdmissibleParams}
   287	    {error pointError lineError : ℝ} {setting : ProjectiveSetting params error}
   288	    {points : CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError}
   289	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError)

   298	            (projX (directPointToPauli params point))

   378	/-- The ordered Z-then-X point overlap on the actual subline law. -/
   379	def orderedSublineOverlap {params : AdmissibleParams} {error pointError lineError : ℝ}
   380	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (points : CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError)
   381	    (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError) (first second : Placement)
   382	    (sample : SubLineTriple params) : ℝ :=
   383	  avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)) (fun parameter =>
   384	    let point := directPointToPauli params (sample.1.base + parameter • sample.1.direction)
   385	    ∑ pair, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   386	      (setting.place first ((lines.T first.side sample.2.1 sample.2.2).effect pair) *
   387	        setting.place second
   388	          ((setting.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z (projZ point)).effect
   389	              (evalOpt sample.2.2 (projZ point) pair.2) *
   390	            (setting.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X (projX point)).effect
   391	              (evalOpt sample.2.1 (projX point) pair.1))))

   393	/-- The first-route replacement by the ordered point product holds for any
   394	placement, in particular for the missing second-player orientation. Its only
   395	distributional input is the uniform joint point marginal, not a product law
   396	conditional on the projected lines. -/
   397	theorem SubLineWitness.paired_ordered_overlap_gap_le {params : AdmissibleParams}

   400	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError)

   403	      avgOver sublines.D (orderedSublineOverlap setting points lines first second)| ≤
   404	        Real.sqrt (4 * pointError) := by
   405	  let law := Distribution.prod sublines.D
   406	    (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd))
   407	  let point (sample : SubLineTriple params × DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd) :=
   408	    directPointToPauli params (sample.1.1.base + sample.2 • sample.1.1.direction)
   409	  let lineMeasurement (sample : SubLineTriple params × DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd) :=
   410	    setting.placedMeasurement first
   411	      ((lines.T first.side sample.1.2.1 sample.1.2.2).postprocess (fun pair =>
   412	        (evalOpt sample.1.2.1 (projX (point sample)) pair.1,
   413	          evalOpt sample.1.2.2 (projZ (point sample)) pair.2)))
   414	  let joint (sample : SubLineTriple params × DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)
   415	      (answer : Option (PauliScalar params) × Option (PauliScalar params)) :=
   416	    setting.place second (((points.Q second.side (projX (point sample))
   417	      (projZ (point sample))).postprocess (fun values => (some values.1, some values.2))).effect
   418	        answer)
   419	  let ordered (sample : SubLineTriple params × DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)
   420	      (answer : Option (PauliScalar params) × Option (PauliScalar params)) :=
   421	    setting.place second
   422	      ((setting.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z (projZ (point sample))).effect answer.2 *
   423	        (setting.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X (projX (point sample))).effect answer.1)

   425	    (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   426	  have hdist : opFamilyDistSq law joint ordered setting.psiHat ≤ 4 * pointError := by
   427	    unfold opFamilyDistSq
   428	    change avgOver law (fun sample => ∑ answer,
   429	      ‖applyOperatorToState (joint sample answer - ordered sample answer) setting.psiHat‖ ^ 2) ≤ _
   430	    have hcompleted := avgOver_congr law _ _ (fun sample =>
   431	      setting.completedPair_norm_sq_sum_ZX points second
   432	        (projX (point sample)) (projZ (point sample)))

   434	    rw [hcompleted]
   435	    change avgOver law (fun sample => ∑ answer : PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params,
   436	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   437	        (setting.place second ((points.Q second.side (projX (point sample))
   438	          (projZ (point sample))).effect answer) -
   439	          setting.place second
   440	            ((setting.pointMeasExp second.side .Z (projZ (point sample))).effect answer.2 *
   441	              (setting.pointMeasExp second.side .X (projX (point sample))).effect answer.1))
   442	        setting.psiHat‖ ^ 2) ≤ _
   443	    rw [show law = Distribution.prod sublines.D
   444	      (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)) from rfl, avgOver_prod]
   445	    dsimp only [point]
   446	    rw [SubLineWitness.avgOver_projX_projZ params sublines
   447	      (fun coordinates => ∑ answer : PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params,
   448	        ‖applyOperatorToState
   449	          (setting.place second ((points.Q second.side coordinates.1 coordinates.2).effect answer) -
   450	            setting.place second
   451	              ((setting.pointMeasExp second.side .Z coordinates.2).effect answer.2 *
   452	                (setting.pointMeasExp second.side .X coordinates.1).effect answer.1))
   453	          setting.psiHat‖ ^ 2)]
   454	    exact points.orderedZX_dist_le second

   456	    setting.psiHat hprob setting.psiHat_norm (4 * pointError) hdist
   457	  have hregroup (right : (SubLineTriple params × DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd) →
   458	      Option (PauliScalar params) × Option (PauliScalar params) →
   459	        Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side)) :
   460	      avgOver law (fun sample => ∑ answer, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   461	        ((lineMeasurement sample).effect answer * setting.place second (right sample answer))) =
   462	      avgOver sublines.D (fun sample =>
   463	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)) (fun parameter =>
   464	          ∑ pair, stateQForm setting.psiHat
   465	            (setting.place first ((lines.T first.side sample.2.1 sample.2.2).effect pair) *
   466	              setting.place second (right (sample, parameter)
   467	                (evalOpt sample.2.1 (projX (point (sample, parameter))) pair.1,
   468	                  evalOpt sample.2.2 (projZ (point (sample, parameter))) pair.2))))) := by
   469	    change avgOver (Distribution.prod sublines.D
   470	      (uniformDistribution (DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd))) _ = _
   471	    rw [avgOver_prod]
   472	    apply avgOver_congr
   473	    intro sample
   474	    apply avgOver_congr
   475	    intro parameter
   476	    exact placed_overlap_postprocess setting first second _ _ _
   477	  dsimp only [joint, ordered] at hgap
   478	  rw [hregroup, hregroup] at hgap

    27	/-- A positive atom gives a positive atom of every push-forward. -/
    28	private theorem map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos {Source Target : Type*}
    29	    [DecidableEq Target] (law : Distribution Source) (mapping : Source → Target)
    30	    (sample : Source) (hpositive : 0 < law.weight sample) :
    31	    0 < (law.map mapping).weight (mapping sample) := by
    32	  classical
    33	  have hmem : sample ∈ law.support := by
    34	    by_contra hnot
    35	    simp [law.outsideSupport sample hnot] at hpositive
    36	  exact hpositive.trans_le (Finset.single_le_sum
    37	    (fun other _ => law.nonnegative other) (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hmem, rfl⟩))

    39	/-- Every canonical direct line has positive marginal mass. In particular, the
    40	conditional distribution in the construction at paper lines 1118--1132 is defined
    41	on every direct line, including zero-direction diagonal lines. -/
    42	theorem directLinePointDist_line_weight_pos (params : DirectLdParams)
    43	    (line : DirectLineDesc params) :
    44	    0 < ((directLinePointDist params).map Prod.fst).weight line := by
    45	  have huniform (sample : DirectLdSpace params) :
    46	      0 < (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace params)).weight sample := by
    47	    rw [uniformDistribution_weight_apply]
    48	    positivity
    49	  suffices hpoint : 0 < (directLinePointDist params).weight (line, line.base) by
    50	    exact map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos _ Prod.fst _ hpoint
    51	  cases line with
    52	  | axis base index baseFixed =>
    53	    let sample : DirectLdSpace params := ⟨base, index, 0⟩
    54	    have haxis := map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos
    55	      (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace params))
    56	      (fun source => (directALineDescOf params source, source.point)) sample (huniform sample)
    57	    have hdecode : directALineDescOf params sample = .axis base index baseFixed := by
    58	      simp [directALineDescOf, sample, baseFixed]
    59	    change 0 < (directALinePointDist params).weight _ at haxis
    60	    rw [hdecode] at haxis
    61	    have hother := (directDLinePointDist params).nonnegative
    62	      (DirectLineDesc.axis base index baseFixed, base)
    63	    change 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (directALinePointDist params).weight _ +
    64	      (1 - 1 / 2) * (directDLinePointDist params).weight _
    65	    change 0 < (directALinePointDist params).weight
    66	      (DirectLineDesc.axis base index baseFixed, base) at haxis
    67	    dsimp only [DirectLineDesc.base]
    68	    linarith
    69	  | diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero =>
    70	    let sample : DirectLdSpace params := ⟨base, index, direction⟩
    71	    have hprefix : directPrefixProjection index direction = direction := by
    72	      funext coordinate
    73	      simp only [directPrefixProjection]
    74	      split_ifs with hbefore
    75	      · exact (prefixZero coordinate hbefore).symm
    76	      · rfl
    77	    have hdiagonal := map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos
    78	      (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace params))
    79	      (fun source => (directDLineDescOf params source, source.point)) sample (huniform sample)
    80	    have hdecode : directDLineDescOf params sample =
    81	        .diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero := by
    82	      simp [directDLineDescOf, sample, hprefix, baseFixed]
    83	    change 0 < (directDLinePointDist params).weight _ at hdiagonal
    84	    rw [hdecode] at hdiagonal
    85	    have hother := (directALinePointDist params).nonnegative
    86	      (DirectLineDesc.diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero, base)
    87	    change 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (directALinePointDist params).weight _ +
    88	      (1 - 1 / 2) * (directDLinePointDist params).weight _
    89	    change 0 < (directDLinePointDist params).weight
    90	      (DirectLineDesc.diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero, base) at hdiagonal
    91	    dsimp only [DirectLineDesc.base]
    92	    linarith

   107	/-- The genuine conditional law of the supported subline triples given their

   171	/-- The directly indexed form of the extended-line POVM at paper lines
   172	1118--1132: condition the subline law and average the postprocessed paired-line POVMs. -/
   173	def SubLineWitness.extendedMeasurement {params : AdmissibleParams}
   174	    {error pointError lineError : ℝ} {setting : ProjectiveSetting params error}
   175	    {points : CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError}
   176	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError)
   177	    (side : PlayerSide) (line : DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd) :
   178	    Quantum.Measurement (DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1))
   179	      (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace side) := by
   180	  let family (sample : sublines.Fiber line) :=
   181	    (lines.T side sample.val.2.1 sample.val.2.2).postprocess
   182	      (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample.val (Finset.mem_filter.mp sample.property).1)
   183	  have hsum : (∑ polynomial, averageOperatorOverDistribution (sublines.conditionalLaw line)
   184	      (fun sample => (family sample).effect polynomial)) = 1 := by
   185	    rw [← averageOperatorOverDistribution_sum]
   186	    simp only [Quantum.Measurement.sum_eq_one]
   187	    exact averageOperatorOverDistribution_const_of_isProbability _
   188	      (sublines.conditionalLaw_isProbability line) 1
   189	  exact { effect := fun polynomial => averageOperatorOverDistribution
   190	            (sublines.conditionalLaw line) (fun sample => (family sample).effect polynomial)
   191	          pos := fun polynomial => averageOperatorOverDistribution_nonneg _ _
   192	            (fun sample => (family sample).pos polynomial)
   193	          sum_le_one := le_of_eq hsum
   194	          sum_eq_one := hsum }

   196	/-- Integrating the conditional law recovers the original subline law.
   197	This is finite disintegration, not an independence assertion about projections. -/
   198	theorem SubLineWitness.avgOver_conditionalLaw {params : AdmissibleParams}
   199	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (quantity : SubLineTriple params → ℝ) :
   200	    avgOver (sublines.D.map Prod.fst) (fun line =>
   201	      avgOver (sublines.conditionalLaw line) (fun sample => quantity sample.val)) =
   202	        avgOver sublines.D quantity := by
   203	  classical
   204	  simp only [avgOver, SubLineWitness.conditionalLaw]
   205	  calc
   206	    (∑ line ∈ (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).support,
   207	        (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line *
   208	          ∑ sample : sublines.Fiber line,
   209	            (sublines.D.weight sample.val / (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line) *
   210	              quantity sample.val) =
   211	        ∑ line ∈ (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).support,
   212	          ∑ sample ∈ sublines.D.support.filter (fun sample => sample.1 = line),
   213	            sublines.D.weight sample * quantity sample := by
   214	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   215	      intro line _
   216	      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   217	      trans ∑ sample : sublines.Fiber line, sublines.D.weight sample.val * quantity sample.val
   218	      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   219	        intro sample _
   220	        field_simp [(sublines.fiber_mass_pos line).ne']
   221	        exact (div_eq_iff (sublines.fiber_mass_pos line).ne').mpr (by ring)
   222	      · exact Finset.sum_coe_sort
   223	          (sublines.D.support.filter (fun sample => sample.1 = line))
   224	          (fun sample => sublines.D.weight sample * quantity sample)
   225	    _ = ∑ sample ∈ sublines.D.support, sublines.D.weight sample * quantity sample := by
   226	      exact Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
   227	        (fun sample hsample => Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨sample, hsample, rfl⟩) _

   263	      (projX (directPointToPauli params point)) valueX)

   327	    have hpower := Polynomial.natDegree_pow_le
   328	      (p := (Polynomial.X : Polynomial Scalar)) (n := index.val)

   348	theorem combineLinePoly_axis_degree {Scalar : Type*} [Field Scalar] {bound degree : ℕ}
   349	    (hdegree : 1 ≤ degree) (data : Fin 8 → Scalar)
   350	    (polynomialX polynomialZ : Fin (bound + 1) → Scalar)
   351	    (hdegreeX : ∀ index, degree < index.val → polynomialX index = 0)
   352	    (hdegreeZ : ∀ index, degree < index.val → polynomialZ index = 0)
   353	    (haxis : (data 5 = 0 ∧ data 7 = 0) ∨ (data 1 = 0 ∧ data 3 = 0)) :
   354	    ∀ index : Fin (bound + 1 + 1), degree < index.val →
   355	      combineLinePoly (data 0) (data 1) (data 2) (data 3)
   356	        (data 4) (data 5) (data 6) (data 7) polynomialX polynomialZ index = 0 := by
   357	  have hpolyX := linePolynomial_natDegree_le_of_coefficients polynomialX hdegreeX
   358	  have hpolyZ := linePolynomial_natDegree_le_of_coefficients polynomialZ hdegreeZ
   359	  have htotal : (combineLinePolynomial (data 0) (data 1) (data 2) (data 3)
   360	      (data 4) (data 5) (data 6) (data 7) polynomialX polynomialZ).natDegree ≤ degree := by
   361	    unfold combineLinePolynomial
   362	    rcases haxis with ⟨halpha, hbeta⟩ | ⟨hparamX, hparamZ⟩
   363	    · simp only [halpha, hbeta, Polynomial.C_0, zero_mul, add_zero]
   364	      refine (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
   365	      · refine Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
   366	        simpa only [Polynomial.natDegree_C, Nat.zero_add] using
   367	          (affine_comp_natDegree_le _ (data 0) (data 1) hpolyX)
   368	      · refine Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
   369	        simpa only [Polynomial.natDegree_C, Nat.zero_add] using
   370	          (affine_comp_natDegree_le _ (data 2) (data 3) hpolyZ)
   371	    · simp only [hparamX, hparamZ, Polynomial.C_0, zero_mul, add_zero, Polynomial.comp_C]

   373	          ((Polynomial.C constant + Polynomial.C slope * Polynomial.X) *
   374	            Polynomial.C value).natDegree ≤ degree := by
   375	        refine Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
   376	        simp only [Polynomial.natDegree_C, Nat.add_zero]
   377	        exact (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le (by simp)
   378	          (Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans (by simpa using hdegree)))
   379	      exact (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le (hterm _ _ _) (hterm _ _ _))
   380	  intro index hindex
   381	  exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (htotal.trans_lt hindex)

   393	/-- Two equal points on a nonzero affine direction force the parameter slope to vanish. -/
   394	private theorem affine_slope_eq_zero {Scalar : Type*} [Field Scalar] {dimension : ℕ}
   395	    {point base direction : Fin dimension → Scalar} {offset slope : Scalar}
   396	    (hdirection : direction ≠ 0) (hzero : point = base + offset • direction)
   397	    (hone : point = base + (offset + slope) • direction) : slope = 0 := by
   398	  have hequal := add_left_cancel (hzero.symm.trans hone)
   399	  have hvanish : slope • direction = 0 := by
   400	    apply add_left_cancel (a := offset • direction)
   401	    simpa only [add_smul, add_zero] using hequal.symm

   413	  have hcoordinate : directPointToPauli params sample.1.direction =
   414	      coordinateDirection sample.1.index := by

   416	    cases line with
   417	    | axis => exact directPointToPauli_coordinateDirection params _

   419	  by_cases hspecial : sample.1.index = alphaVar params.m ∨ sample.1.index = betaVar params.m

   464	theorem SubLineWitness.extendedMeasurement_axis_degree {params : AdmissibleParams}

   466	    {points : CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError}
   467	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError)

   474	    ((lines.T side sample.val.2.1 sample.val.2.2).postprocess
   475	      (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample.val
   476	        (Finset.mem_filter.mp sample.property).1)).effect polynomial) = 0
   477	  unfold averageOperatorOverDistribution
   478	  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
   479	  intro sample _
   480	  have hsample := (Finset.mem_filter.mp sample.property).1
   481	  have hsampleAxis : sample.val.1.kind = .axis := by

   488	      hzero).trans (smul_zero _)
   489	  rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   490	  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
   491	  intro pair hpair

   497	      exact (hdegree hfit).elim

     5	/-!
     6	# Indicator-weighted ordered projectors
     7	
     8	This module proves the local norm calculation in `eq:qld-g-prime`. The state
     9	vector is not assumed normalized: its squared norm controls the exceptional
    10	coefficient, so the estimate can be summed over all polynomial outcomes.
    11	The measurements act on an arbitrary finite space, which includes either
    12	player's placed expanded measurements.
    13	
    14	The coefficient-polynomial argument also bounds mass outside the scalar-linear
    15	image, with its actual ordered-correlation error displayed in the conclusion.
    16	These are auxiliary estimates, not the global polynomial-pair construction.
    17	The remaining block-separation and construction obligations are recorded in
    18	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex` and issue #513.
    19	
    20	Only the dependency chain needed for these estimates is exposed; supporting
    21	lemmas remain private.
    22	
    23	## References
    24	
    25	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1289-1326`,
    26	  especially `eq:qld-g-42`, `eq:qld-g-43`, and `eq:qld-g-prime`.
    27	-/

    43	/-- The ordered product selected by the linear field-answer check in
    44	`eq:qld-g-42`. This is an operator, not an asserted measurement effect. -/
    45	def orderedIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    46	  ∑ bc : F × F, if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    47	
    48	/-- The diagonal sandwich sum in `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
    49	def diagonalIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    50	  ∑ bc : F × F,
    51	    if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then
    52	      Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    53	
    54	/-- For a nonzero second coefficient, X orthogonality and cancellation in
    55	the field eliminate every off-diagonal term of the ordered Gram operator.
    56	This is the exact local algebra behind `eq:qld-g-prime`; no commutation of
    57	the X and Z measurements is assumed. -/
    58	private theorem orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    59	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    60	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a =
    61	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a := by
    62	  classical
    63	  unfold orderedIndicator diagonalIndicator
    64	  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    65	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun bc _ => ?_
    66	  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single bc]
    67	  · by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    68	    · simp only [if_pos h, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, measurement_effect_hermitian]
    69	      rw [mul_assoc (Z.effect bc.2), ← mul_assoc (X.effect bc.1),
    70	        (hX bc.1).isIdempotentElem.eq, ← mul_assoc]
    71	    · simp [h]
    72	  · intro bc' _ hne
    73	    by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    74	    · by_cases h' : α * bc'.1 + β * bc'.2 = a
    75	      · have hb : bc.1 ≠ bc'.1 := by
    76	          intro hb
    77	          have hc : bc.2 = bc'.2 := mul_left_cancel₀ hβ (by
    78	            apply add_left_cancel (a := α * bc.1)
    79	            simpa only [hb] using h.trans h'.symm)
    80	          exact hne (Prod.ext hb hc).symm
    81	        simp only [if_pos h, if_pos h', Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    82	          measurement_effect_hermitian]
    83	        calc
    84	          Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * (X.effect bc'.1 * Z.effect bc'.2) =
    85	              Z.effect bc.2 * (X.effect bc.1 * X.effect bc'.1) * Z.effect bc'.2 := by
    86	            simp only [mul_assoc]
    87	          _ = 0 := by rw [projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero X hX hb]; simp
    88	      · simp [h']
    89	    · simp [h]
    90	  · simp

    92	/-- The squared state norm of the ordered indicator equals its diagonal
    93	sandwich quadratic form when the second coefficient is nonzero. -/
    94	private theorem orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    95	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    96	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    97	    ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 =
    98	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) := by
    99	  rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq,
   100	    orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   101	  rfl

   103	/-- The diagonal indicator is a positive contraction, since it selects
   104	effects from the complete sandwich POVM. -/
   105	private theorem diagonalIndicator_bounds (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   106	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   107	    0 ≤ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ∧ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   108	  obtain ⟨hpos, hsum⟩ := pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ
   109	  change (∀ bc : F × F, 0 ≤ Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) at hpos
   110	  change (∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) = 1 at hsum
   111	  constructor
   112	  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun bc _ => by
   113	      split_ifs
   114	      · exact hpos bc
   115	      · exact le_refl 0
   116	  · calc
   117	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤
   118	          ∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 := by
   119	        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun bc _ => ?_
   120	        split_ifs
   121	        · exact le_refl _
   122	        · exact hpos bc
   123	      _ = 1 := hsum

   125	/-- At the exceptional coefficient zero, completeness of Z leaves a
   126	coarse-grained X projection. This includes zero first coefficient. -/
   127	private theorem orderedIndicator_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α a : F) :
   128	    orderedIndicator X Z α 0 a = (X.postprocess (fun b => α * b)).effect a := by
   129	  unfold orderedIndicator
   130	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
   131	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   132	  by_cases h : α * b = a
   133	  · simp only [zero_mul, add_zero, h, if_true]
   134	    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Z.sum_eq_one, mul_one]
   135	  · simp [h]

   137	/-- Every linear-answer ordered indicator is a contraction. For nonzero
   138	second coefficient this follows from the diagonal identity; at zero it
   139	follows from completeness and projective postprocessing. -/
   140	theorem orderedIndicator_gram_le_one (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   141	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   142	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   143	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   144	  · subst β
   145	    rw [orderedIndicator_zero, measurement_effect_hermitian,
   146	      (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective X hX (fun b => α * b) a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   147	    exact measurement_effect_le_one _ _
   148	  · rw [orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   149	    exact (diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a).2

   151	/-- The pointwise error in `eq:qld-g-prime` is supported on the zero second
   152	coefficient and bounded by the squared norm of the actual state vector. -/
   153	theorem abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   154	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   155	    (α β a : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   156	    |‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   157	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a)| ≤
   158	      if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
   159	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   160	  · rw [if_pos hβ]
   161	    have hA0 := sq_nonneg ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖
   162	    have hA1 : ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   163	      rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, ← stateQForm_one ψ]
   164	      exact quadratic_form_mono (orderedIndicator_gram_le_one X Z hX hZ α β a) ψ
   165	    have hD := diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a
   166	    have hD0 := stateQForm_nonneg ψ hD.1
   167	    have hD1 : stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   168	      rw [← stateQForm_one ψ]
   169	      exact quadratic_form_mono hD.2 ψ
   170	    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
   171	  · rw [if_neg hβ, orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ ψ]
   172	    simp

   174	/-- Completeness and projectivity preserve total squared state mass. This is
   175	the normalization used after summing `eq:qld-g-prime` over polynomial labels. -/
   176	theorem sum_projective_state_norm_sq {Γ : Type*} [Fintype Γ]
   177	    (S : Quantum.Measurement Γ ι) (hS : Measurement.IsProjective S)
   178	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   179	    ∑ g : Γ, ‖applyOperatorToState (S.effect g) ψ‖ ^ 2 = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   180	  simp_rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, measurement_effect_hermitian,
   181	    fun g => (hS g).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   182	  change (∑ g : Γ, stateQForm ψ (S.effect g)) = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2
   183	  rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, S.sum_eq_one, stateQForm_one]

   185	/-- A polynomial not of the form `alpha * u + beta * v` has a nonzero
   186	coefficient outside those two monomials. Applied over the ring of base-point
   187	polynomials, this chooses one coefficient independently of both measurement
   188	outcomes in the argument following `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
   189	private theorem exists_nonzero_nonlinear_coeff {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
   190	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R)
   191	    (hp : ¬ ∃ u v : R, p = MvPolynomial.C u * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   192	      MvPolynomial.C v * MvPolynomial.X 1) :
   193	    ∃ e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, e ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1 ∧ e ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 ∧
   194	      p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
   195	  classical
   196	  have h01 : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := by
   197	    intro h
   198	    simpa using congrArg (fun e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => e 0) h
   199	  by_contra! h
   200	  apply hp
   201	  refine ⟨p.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 1), p.coeff (Finsupp.single 1 1), ?_⟩
   202	  ext e
   203	  by_cases h0 : e = Finsupp.single 0 1
   204	  · subst e
   205	    simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, Ne.symm h01]
   206	  · by_cases h1 : e = Finsupp.single 1 1
   207	    · subst e
   208	      simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, h01]
   209	    · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, Ne.symm h0, Ne.symm h1,
   210	        h e h0 h1]

   212	omit [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] in
   213	/-- A nonzero specialized coefficient outside the scalar-linear monomials
   214	certifies nonzero difference from every `alpha * b + beta * c` simultaneously.
   215	This is the common good-base-point criterion needed before sandwich weighting. -/
   216	private theorem specialization_ne_linear_of_coeff {n : ℕ}
   217	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)
   218	    (he0 : e ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1) (he1 : e ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1)
   219	    (u : Fin n → F) (hu : MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) ≠ 0) (b c : F) :
   220	    MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p ≠
   221	      MvPolynomial.C b * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 := by
   222	  intro h
   223	  apply hu
   224	  have hc := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff e) h

     4	/-!
     5	# Common exceptional fibers for polynomial coefficients
     6	
     7	A nonconstant polynomial in one block, with polynomial coefficients in a
     8	second block, has a nonzero coefficient at a nonconstant monomial. Its zero set controls
     9	all exceptional specializations simultaneously, independently of the outcome
    10	of a measurement. The weights may depend on the fixed block but not on the
    11	block being averaged.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1341-1358`,
    16	especially `eq:qld-g-2`; support for blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolynomialImageBounds
    22

    24	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

    27	
    28	variable {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]

    30	private theorem exists_nonconstant_coeff {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ}
    31	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r) :
    32	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
    33	  classical
    34	  by_contra! h
    35	  apply hp
    36	  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    37	  ext e
    38	  by_cases he : e = 0
    39	  · simp [he]
    40	  · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he, h e he]
    41	
    42	/-- A single coefficient defines the exceptional slices for every field
    43	outcome. Outside its zero set, every fiber has probability at most `D/q`;
    44	the exceptional set itself has probability at most `C/q`. Both degree
    45	conditions concern the displayed polynomial, not an assumed collision law.
    46	This is the common-set argument following `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting
    47	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    48	theorem exists_common_exceptional_coefficient {n k C D : ℕ}
    49	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    50	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    51	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D) :
    52	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 ∧
    53	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F))
    54	        (fun z => if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
    55	          (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F ∧
    56	      ∀ z : Fin k → F, MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) ≠ 0 → ∀ b : F,
    57	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    58	          (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    59	            then 1 else 0) ≤ (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F := by
    60	  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := exists_nonconstant_coeff p hp
    61	  refine ⟨e, he, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
    62	  · simpa using avg_eval_eq_le (p.coeff e) 0 hc (hcoeff e) (by simp)
    63	  · intro z hz b
    64	    have hne : MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p ≠ MvPolynomial.C b := by
    65	      intro h
    66	      apply hz
    67	      have h' := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff e) h
    68	      simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff_map, MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he] using h'
    69	    have hd : (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p).totalDegree ≤ D :=
    70	      (Finset.sup_mono (MvPolynomial.support_map_subset _ _)).trans hdegree
    71	    simpa using avg_eval_eq_le _ (MvPolynomial.C b) hne hd (by simp)
    72	
    73	/-- Summing all nonnegative outcome weights before averaging exceptional
    74	slices avoids an outcome-cardinality factor. The weights may depend on `z`
    75	and their sum is the same mass `M` at every `z`. This is the weighted fiber
    76	calculation in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    77	theorem avg_weighted_fiber_le {n k C D : ℕ}
    78	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    79	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    80	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D)
    81	    (w : (Fin k → F) → F → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    82	    (hw : ∀ z b, 0 ≤ w z b) (hsum : ∀ z, ∑ b, w z b = M) :
    83	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z => ∑ b : F,
    84	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    85	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    86	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤ ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    87	  classical
    88	  obtain ⟨e, _, _, hbad, hgood⟩ :=
    89	    exists_common_exceptional_coefficient p hp hcoeff hdegree
    90	  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by
    91	    rw [← hsum (fun _ => 0)]
    92	    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => hw _ b
    93	  have hpoint (z : Fin k → F) :
    94	      (∑ b : F, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    95	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    96	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤
    97	      (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
    98	        (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    99	    by_cases hz : MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0
   100	    · simp only [hz, if_true, one_mul]
   101	      apply le_trans (b := M)
   102	      · rw [← hsum z]
   103	        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   104	        intro b _
   105	        apply le_trans (b := 1 * w z b)
   106	        · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hw z b)
   107	          apply avgOver_uniform_le_const
   108	          intro x
   109	          split_ifs <;> norm_num
   110	        · rw [one_mul]
   111	      · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hM)
   112	    · simp only [hz, if_false, zero_mul, zero_add]
   113	      rw [← hsum z, Finset.mul_sum]
   114	      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ =>
   115	        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgood z hz b) (hw z b)
   116	  calc
   117	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   118	        (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
   119	          (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M) := avgOver_mono _ _ _ hpoint
   120	    _ ≤ (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M + (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
   121	      rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_mul_const, avgOver_uniform_const]
   122	      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbad hM) le_rfl
   123	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

   133	        stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t * X.effect r * Z.effect t) := by
   134	  classical

   153	        if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
   154	        if bc = (r, t) then 1 else (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ := by

   156	    exact affine_collision_average bc (r, t)
   157	  simp_rw [hexpand, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const, hcollision]

   162	      intro bc _

   241	      intro z

   248	            (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b

   252	        ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := add_le_add le_rfl hfiber

    87	      2 * extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R reverse +
    88	        2 * (((P.m * P.d + P.m * P.d + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) := by
    89	  classical
    90	  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun g =>
    91	    (∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),
    92	      scalarPolynomial P g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
    93	        MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1) ∧
    94	    ¬ ∃ r, blockCoefficientPolynomial P g
    95	      (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 0 else 1) 1) reverse = MvPolynomial.C r)
    96	  let ψ := fun g => applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 (R.effect g)) S.psiHat
    97	  let X := fun x : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P => S.placedMeasurement p2
    98	    (S.pointMeasExp p2.side (if reverse then .Z else .X) x)
    99	  let Z := fun z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P => S.placedMeasurement p2
   100	    (S.pointMeasExp p2.side (if reverse then .X else .Z) z)
   101	  let A := fun (z x : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) g =>
   102	    applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X x) (Z z) (v 0) (v 1)
   103	      (extendedPolynomialRead P (fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v)) g)) (ψ g)

   106	    simpa only [ψ, ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect, S.psiHat_norm, one_pow] using

   109	  have hnorm (g) (hg : g ∈ s) :
   110	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun z =>
   111	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
   112	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
   113	            ‖A z x v g‖ ^ 2))) ≤ B * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := by

   115	    have hd := blockCoefficientPolynomial_degrees P g
   116	      (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 0 else 1) 1) reverse
   117	    have h := avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_nonconstant
   118	      (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 0 else 1) 1) reverse)

   120	      (fun x z => MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   121	        (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g
   122	          (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 1 else 0) 1) reverse))) X Z
   123	      (fun x => S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p2 _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _))
   124	      (fun z => S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p2 _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _)) (ψ g)

   126	      @FieldModel.card P.q P.model.toFieldModel
   127	    simpa only [A, scalarPolynomial_linear_read_fiber P g hlin, hcard, B] using h
   128	  have hnormsum :
   129	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun z =>
   130	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
   131	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
   132	            ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A z x v g‖ ^ 2))) ≤ B := by
   133	    simp_rw [avgOver_finset_sum]

   135	      _ ≤ ∑ g ∈ s, B * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_le_sum hnorm
   136	      _ ≤ ∑ g, B * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 :=
   137	        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (by
   138	          intros; dsimp [B]; positivity)
   139	      _ = B := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hmass, mul_one]
   140	  have hfull :
   141	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun z =>
   142	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
   143	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
   144	            ∑ g, ‖ψ g - A z x v g‖ ^ 2))) =
   145	        extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R reverse := by

   155	    rintro ⟨⟨z, x⟩, v⟩
   156	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   157	    intro g _
   158	    dsimp only [A, X, Z]

   160	    dsimp only [ψ]
   161	    rw [placed_residual S p1 p2 hopposite]
   162	    rfl

   171	    intro z
   172	    apply avgOver_mono
   173	    intro x
   174	    apply avgOver_mono
   175	    intro v
   176	    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (by
   177	      intros; exact sq_nonneg _)
   178	  have h := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) _ _ fun z =>
   179	    avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) _ _ fun x =>
   180	      avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) _ _ fun v =>
   181	        sum_mass_le_residual_add_image s ψ (A z x v)
   182	  simp only [avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_add, avgOver_const_mul] at h
   183	  change scalarWrongVariableMass S p1 R reverse ≤ _ at h

   196	theorem exists_rounded_polynomial_wrong_variable_mass :

   203	      let eta := delta + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow delta (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +

     4	/-!
     5	# Common exceptional fibers for polynomial coefficients
     6	
     7	A nonconstant polynomial in one block, with polynomial coefficients in a
     8	second block, has a nonzero coefficient at a nonconstant monomial. Its zero set controls
     9	all exceptional specializations simultaneously, independently of the outcome
    10	of a measurement. The weights may depend on the fixed block but not on the
    11	block being averaged.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1341-1358`,
    16	especially `eq:qld-g-2`; support for blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolynomialImageBounds
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    24	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	variable {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
    29	
    30	private theorem exists_nonconstant_coeff {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ}
    31	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r) :
    32	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
    33	  classical
    34	  by_contra! h
    35	  apply hp
    36	  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    37	  ext e
    38	  by_cases he : e = 0
    39	  · simp [he]
    40	  · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he, h e he]
    41	
    42	/-- A single coefficient defines the exceptional slices for every field
    43	outcome. Outside its zero set, every fiber has probability at most `D/q`;
    44	the exceptional set itself has probability at most `C/q`. Both degree
    45	conditions concern the displayed polynomial, not an assumed collision law.
    46	This is the common-set argument following `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting
    47	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    48	theorem exists_common_exceptional_coefficient {n k C D : ℕ}
    49	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    50	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    51	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D) :
    52	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 ∧
    53	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F))
    54	        (fun z => if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
    55	          (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F ∧
    56	      ∀ z : Fin k → F, MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) ≠ 0 → ∀ b : F,
    57	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    58	          (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    59	            then 1 else 0) ≤ (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F := by
    60	  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := exists_nonconstant_coeff p hp
    61	  refine ⟨e, he, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
    62	  · simpa using avg_eval_eq_le (p.coeff e) 0 hc (hcoeff e) (by simp)
    63	  · intro z hz b
    64	    have hne : MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p ≠ MvPolynomial.C b := by
    65	      intro h
    66	      apply hz
    67	      have h' := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff e) h
    68	      simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff_map, MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he] using h'
    69	    have hd : (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p).totalDegree ≤ D :=
    70	      (Finset.sup_mono (MvPolynomial.support_map_subset _ _)).trans hdegree
    71	    simpa using avg_eval_eq_le _ (MvPolynomial.C b) hne hd (by simp)
    72	
    73	/-- Summing all nonnegative outcome weights before averaging exceptional
    74	slices avoids an outcome-cardinality factor. The weights may depend on `z`
    75	and their sum is the same mass `M` at every `z`. This is the weighted fiber
    76	calculation in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    77	theorem avg_weighted_fiber_le {n k C D : ℕ}
    78	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    79	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    80	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D)
    81	    (w : (Fin k → F) → F → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    82	    (hw : ∀ z b, 0 ≤ w z b) (hsum : ∀ z, ∑ b, w z b = M) :
    83	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z => ∑ b : F,
    84	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    85	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    86	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤ ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    87	  classical
    88	  obtain ⟨e, _, _, hbad, hgood⟩ :=
    89	    exists_common_exceptional_coefficient p hp hcoeff hdegree
    90	  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by
    91	    rw [← hsum (fun _ => 0)]
    92	    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => hw _ b
    93	  have hpoint (z : Fin k → F) :
    94	      (∑ b : F, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    95	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    96	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤
    97	      (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
    98	        (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    99	    by_cases hz : MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0
   100	    · simp only [hz, if_true, one_mul]
   101	      apply le_trans (b := M)
   102	      · rw [← hsum z]
   103	        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   104	        intro b _
   105	        apply le_trans (b := 1 * w z b)
   106	        · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hw z b)
   107	          apply avgOver_uniform_le_const
   108	          intro x
   109	          split_ifs <;> norm_num
   110	        · rw [one_mul]
   111	      · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hM)
   112	    · simp only [hz, if_false, zero_mul, zero_add]
   113	      rw [← hsum z, Finset.mul_sum]
   114	      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ =>
   115	        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgood z hz b) (hw z b)
   116	  calc
   117	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   118	        (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
   119	          (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M) := avgOver_mono _ _ _ hpoint
   120	    _ ≤ (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M + (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
   121	      rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_mul_const, avgOver_uniform_const]
   122	      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbad hM) le_rfl
   123	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

   127	private theorem avg_diagonalIndicator_linear_le
   128	    (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   129	    (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   130	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   131	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t))) ≤
   132	      (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   133	        stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t * X.effect r * Z.effect t) := by
   134	  classical
   135	  let w (bc : F × F) : ℝ := stateQForm ψ
   136	    (Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2)
   137	  have hw (bc : F × F) : 0 ≤ w bc :=
   138	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).1 bc)
   139	  have hsum : ∑ bc, w bc = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   140	    rw [← stateQForm_one ψ, ← (pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).2,
   141	      stateQForm_finset_sum]
   142	    rfl
   143	  have hexpand (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   144	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) =
   145	      ∑ bc : F × F, (if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t
   146	        then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   147	    rw [diagonalIndicator, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   148	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   149	    intro bc _
   150	    split_ifs <;> simp [w, stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
   151	  have hcollision (bc : F × F) :
   152	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   153	        if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
   154	        if bc = (r, t) then 1 else (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
   155	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   156	    exact affine_collision_average bc (r, t)
   157	  simp_rw [hexpand, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const, hcollision]
   158	  calc
   159	    _ ≤ ∑ bc : F × F, ((Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ +
   160	        if bc = (r, t) then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   161	      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   162	      intro bc _
   163	      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hw bc)
   164	      split_ifs <;> simp
   165	    _ = _ := by
   166	      simp_rw [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   167	      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hsum]
   168	      simp [w]

   170	private theorem avg_orderedIndicator_linear_le
   171	    (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X)
   172	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   173	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   174	      ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1)
   175	        (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2) ≤
   176	      2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 + stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t) := by
   177	  have hexc : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   178	      (fun v => if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) =
   179	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   180	    change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   181	      (fun v => if ((finTwoArrowEquiv F) v).2 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) = _
   182	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   183	    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   184	    rw [avgOver_uniform_snd (fun β : F => if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0)]
   185	    simp [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
   186	  have hdrop : stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t * X.effect r * Z.effect t) ≤
   187	      stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t) := by
   188	    apply quadratic_form_mono
   189	    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, measurement_effect_hermitian, mul_one,
   190	      (hZ t).isIdempotentElem.eq] using
   191	      star_left_conjugate_le_conjugate (measurement_effect_le_one X r) (Z.effect t)
   192	  have havg := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ (fun v =>
   193	    le_trans (le_abs_self _) (abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le
   194	      X Z hX hZ (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t) ψ))
   195	  rw [avgOver_sub, hexc] at havg
   196	  have hdiag := avg_diagonalIndicator_linear_le X Z hZ r t ψ
   197	  linarith
   198	
   199	/-- The wrong-variable coefficient is concentrated only after the middle
   200	contraction has been removed. The outer measurement depends solely on the
   201	fixed block `z`; `X` depends solely on the varying block `x`. For the other
   202	class interchange `X,Z` and the two blocks. The vector is arbitrary and
   203	need not be normalized. This proves the local norm bound behind
   204	`eq:qld-g-prime-xpt-bound` and its reversed-order counterpart, supporting
   205	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   206	theorem avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_nonconstant {n k C D : ℕ}
   207	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
   208	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
   209	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D)
   210	    (r : (Fin n → F) → (Fin k → F) → F)
   211	    (X : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   212	    (Z : (Fin k → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   213	    (hX : ∀ x, Measurement.IsProjective (X x))
   214	    (hZ : ∀ z, Measurement.IsProjective (Z z)) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   215	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   216	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun x =>
   217	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   218	          ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X x) (Z z) (v 0) (v 1)
   219	            (v 0 * r x z + v 1 *
   220	              MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))) ψ‖ ^ 2))) ≤
   221	      ((C + D + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   222	  classical
   223	  let w (z : Fin k → F) (b : F) := stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect b)
   224	  have hsum (z : Fin k → F) : ∑ b, w z b = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   225	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, (Z z).sum_eq_one, stateQForm_one]
   226	  have hfiber := avg_weighted_fiber_le p hp hcoeff hdegree w (‖ψ‖ ^ 2)
   227	    (fun z b => stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((Z z).pos b)) hsum
   228	  have heval (z : Fin k → F) (x : Fin n → F) :
   229	      stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect
   230	        (MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))) =
   231	      ∑ b : F, (if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
   232	        then 1 else 0) * w z b := by
   233	    simp [w]
   234	  calc
   235	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   236	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun x =>
   237	          2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   238	          stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect
   239	            (MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))))) := by
   240	      apply avgOver_mono
   241	      intro z
   242	      apply avgOver_mono
   243	      intro x
   244	      exact avg_orderedIndicator_linear_le (X x) (Z z) (hX x) (hZ z) _ _ ψ
   245	    _ = 2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   246	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z => ∑ b : F,
   247	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   248	            (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
   249	              then 1 else 0) * w z b) := by
   250	      simp_rw [heval, avgOver_add, avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const]
   251	    _ ≤ 2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   252	        ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := add_le_add le_rfl hfiber
   253	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring
   254

     5	/-!
     6	# Indicator-weighted ordered projectors
     7	
     8	This module proves the local norm calculation in `eq:qld-g-prime`. The state
     9	vector is not assumed normalized: its squared norm controls the exceptional
    10	coefficient, so the estimate can be summed over all polynomial outcomes.
    11	The measurements act on an arbitrary finite space, which includes either
    12	player's placed expanded measurements.
    13	
    14	The coefficient-polynomial argument also bounds mass outside the scalar-linear
    15	image, with its actual ordered-correlation error displayed in the conclusion.
    16	These are auxiliary estimates, not the global polynomial-pair construction.
    17	The remaining block-separation and construction obligations are recorded in
    18	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex` and issue #513.
    19	
    20	Only the dependency chain needed for these estimates is exposed; supporting
    21	lemmas remain private.
    22	
    23	## References
    24	
    25	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1289-1326`,
    26	  especially `eq:qld-g-42`, `eq:qld-g-43`, and `eq:qld-g-prime`.
    27	-/

    43	/-- The ordered product selected by the linear field-answer check in
    44	`eq:qld-g-42`. This is an operator, not an asserted measurement effect. -/
    45	def orderedIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    46	  ∑ bc : F × F, if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    47	
    48	/-- The diagonal sandwich sum in `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
    49	def diagonalIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    50	  ∑ bc : F × F,
    51	    if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then
    52	      Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    53	
    54	/-- For a nonzero second coefficient, X orthogonality and cancellation in
    55	the field eliminate every off-diagonal term of the ordered Gram operator.
    56	This is the exact local algebra behind `eq:qld-g-prime`; no commutation of
    57	the X and Z measurements is assumed. -/
    58	private theorem orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    59	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    60	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a =
    61	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a := by
    62	  classical
    63	  unfold orderedIndicator diagonalIndicator
    64	  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    65	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun bc _ => ?_
    66	  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single bc]
    67	  · by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    68	    · simp only [if_pos h, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, measurement_effect_hermitian]
    69	      rw [mul_assoc (Z.effect bc.2), ← mul_assoc (X.effect bc.1),
    70	        (hX bc.1).isIdempotentElem.eq, ← mul_assoc]
    71	    · simp [h]
    72	  · intro bc' _ hne
    73	    by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    74	    · by_cases h' : α * bc'.1 + β * bc'.2 = a
    75	      · have hb : bc.1 ≠ bc'.1 := by
    76	          intro hb
    77	          have hc : bc.2 = bc'.2 := mul_left_cancel₀ hβ (by
    78	            apply add_left_cancel (a := α * bc.1)
    79	            simpa only [hb] using h.trans h'.symm)
    80	          exact hne (Prod.ext hb hc).symm
    81	        simp only [if_pos h, if_pos h', Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    82	          measurement_effect_hermitian]
    83	        calc
    84	          Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * (X.effect bc'.1 * Z.effect bc'.2) =
    85	              Z.effect bc.2 * (X.effect bc.1 * X.effect bc'.1) * Z.effect bc'.2 := by
    86	            simp only [mul_assoc]
    87	          _ = 0 := by rw [projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero X hX hb]; simp
    88	      · simp [h']
    89	    · simp [h]
    90	  · simp

    92	/-- The squared state norm of the ordered indicator equals its diagonal
    93	sandwich quadratic form when the second coefficient is nonzero. -/
    94	private theorem orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    95	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    96	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    97	    ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 =
    98	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) := by
    99	  rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq,
   100	    orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   101	  rfl

   103	/-- The diagonal indicator is a positive contraction, since it selects
   104	effects from the complete sandwich POVM. -/
   105	private theorem diagonalIndicator_bounds (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   106	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   107	    0 ≤ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ∧ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   108	  obtain ⟨hpos, hsum⟩ := pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ
   109	  change (∀ bc : F × F, 0 ≤ Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) at hpos
   110	  change (∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) = 1 at hsum
   111	  constructor
   112	  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun bc _ => by
   113	      split_ifs
   114	      · exact hpos bc
   115	      · exact le_refl 0
   116	  · calc
   117	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤
   118	          ∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 := by
   119	        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun bc _ => ?_
   120	        split_ifs
   121	        · exact le_refl _
   122	        · exact hpos bc
   123	      _ = 1 := hsum

   125	/-- At the exceptional coefficient zero, completeness of Z leaves a
   126	coarse-grained X projection. This includes zero first coefficient. -/
   127	private theorem orderedIndicator_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α a : F) :
   128	    orderedIndicator X Z α 0 a = (X.postprocess (fun b => α * b)).effect a := by
   129	  unfold orderedIndicator
   130	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
   131	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   132	  by_cases h : α * b = a
   133	  · simp only [zero_mul, add_zero, h, if_true]
   134	    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Z.sum_eq_one, mul_one]
   135	  · simp [h]

   137	/-- Every linear-answer ordered indicator is a contraction. For nonzero
   138	second coefficient this follows from the diagonal identity; at zero it
   139	follows from completeness and projective postprocessing. -/
   140	theorem orderedIndicator_gram_le_one (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   141	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   142	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   143	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   144	  · subst β
   145	    rw [orderedIndicator_zero, measurement_effect_hermitian,
   146	      (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective X hX (fun b => α * b) a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   147	    exact measurement_effect_le_one _ _
   148	  · rw [orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   149	    exact (diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a).2

   151	/-- The pointwise error in `eq:qld-g-prime` is supported on the zero second
   152	coefficient and bounded by the squared norm of the actual state vector. -/
   153	theorem abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   154	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   155	    (α β a : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   156	    |‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   157	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a)| ≤
   158	      if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
   159	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   160	  · rw [if_pos hβ]
   161	    have hA0 := sq_nonneg ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖
   162	    have hA1 : ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   163	      rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, ← stateQForm_one ψ]
   164	      exact quadratic_form_mono (orderedIndicator_gram_le_one X Z hX hZ α β a) ψ
   165	    have hD := diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a
   166	    have hD0 := stateQForm_nonneg ψ hD.1
   167	    have hD1 : stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   168	      rw [← stateQForm_one ψ]
   169	      exact quadratic_form_mono hD.2 ψ
   170	    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
   171	  · rw [if_neg hβ, orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ ψ]
   172	    simp

   174	/-- Completeness and projectivity preserve total squared state mass. This is
   175	the normalization used after summing `eq:qld-g-prime` over polynomial labels. -/
   176	theorem sum_projective_state_norm_sq {Γ : Type*} [Fintype Γ]

   450	      (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (p g)))) (ψ g)
   451	  have hpoint (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   452	      ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤
   453	        2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A u v g‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A u v g‖ ^ 2 :=
   454	    sum_mass_le_residual_add_image s ψ (A u v)
   455	  have havg := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) _ _ fun u =>
   456	    avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ (hpoint u)
   457	  simp only [avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_add, avgOver_const_mul] at havg
   458	  have hnorm := avg_sum_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear s p hp X Z hX hZ ψ
   459	  change ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   460	    (fun u => avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   461	      (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A u v g‖ ^ 2)) + _
   462	  change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   463	    (fun u => avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   464	      (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A u v g‖ ^ 2)) ≤ _ at hnorm
   465	  linarith
   466	
   467	end PolynomialImageBounds
