    20	/-- On the unit interval, all actual rounding terms are bounded by an eighth
    21	root. The point error is controlled through its square root, as in the direct
    22	passing estimate. The cap uses the independent unit bound on defects. -/
    23	theorem actual_rounding_error_le_root {delta point ratio t : ℝ}
    24	    (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (hp : 0 ≤ point)
    25	    (hdt : delta ≤ t) (hpt : Real.sqrt point ≤ t) (hrt : ratio ≤ t) :
    26	    min 1 (32 * delta + 32 * Real.sqrt (220 * delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
    27	      64 * Real.sqrt (2 * delta) + 64 * point + 30 * ratio) ≤
    28	      1024 * Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (min 1 t))) := by
    29	  have ht : 0 ≤ t := hd.trans hdt
    30	  by_cases ht1 : t ≤ 1
    31	  · rw [min_eq_right ht1]
    32	    have hroot : Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt t)) = t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    33	      simp only [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    34	      rw [← Real.rpow_mul ht, ← Real.rpow_mul ht]
    35	      norm_num
    36	    rw [hroot]
    37	    have h18 : t ≤ t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    38	      simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' ht ht1
    39	        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8) (by norm_num : (1 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    40	    have h14 : t ≤ t ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    41	      simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' ht ht1
    42	        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4) (by norm_num : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    43	    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (t ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) = t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    44	      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul ht]
    45	      norm_num
    46	    have hround : Real.sqrt (220 * delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ≤
    47	        15 * t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    48	      calc
    49	        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (225 * t ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    50	          (mul_le_mul (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_le_rpow hd hdt (by norm_num))
    51	            (Real.rpow_nonneg hd _) (by norm_num))
    52	        _ = _ := by rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), hsqrt]; norm_num
    53	    have hsecond : Real.sqrt (2 * delta) ≤ 2 * t ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    54	      calc
    55	        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (4 * t ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) :=
    56	          Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [Real.rpow_nonneg ht (1 / 4 : ℝ)])
    57	        _ = _ := by rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), hsqrt]; norm_num
    58	    have hpoint : point ≤ t := by
    59	      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hp, Real.sqrt_nonneg point]
    60	    refine (min_le_right _ _).trans ?_
    61	    nlinarith [Real.rpow_nonneg ht (1 / 8 : ℝ)]
    62	  · rw [min_eq_left (le_of_not_ge ht1)]
    63	    norm_num

    65	/-- A fixed positive coefficient can be absorbed by increasing the universal

    69	    K * deltaQld a b epsilon P.m P.d P.q ≤
    70	      deltaQld (K * a) b epsilon P.m P.d P.q := by
    71	  have hmd : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    72	    Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.mul_pos P.one_le_m P.hd)

    75	  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by linarith

    84	      (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hmd haK) (mul_nonneg hK0 ha0)) hsum

   130	  have hpt : Real.sqrt (pointError epsilon) ≤ t := by dsimp [t]; linarith

   134	    have hd' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ P.d := by exact_mod_cast P.hd
   135	    dsimp [ratio]

   137	    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

    26	/-- The fourth directed bipartition, with `BB'` first, `AB''` second, and

    29	def bbAbBipartition (params : AdmissibleParams) (left right : Type*) :
    30	    SixReg params left right ≃
    31	      (right × PauliRegister params) ×
    32	        ((left × PauliRegister params) × (PauliRegister params × PauliRegister params)) where
    33	  toFun indices := ((indices.2.1, indices.2.2.1),

    35	  invFun indices := ((indices.2.1.1, (indices.2.2.1, indices.2.2.2)),

    40	/-- Coordinates of the `BB' | AB''(A'A'')` bipartition. -/

    43	    bbAbBipartition params left right indices =
    44	      ((indices.2.1, indices.2.2.1),

    52	`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:959-963`. -/
    53	theorem ProjectiveSetting.exists_opposite_bipartition {params : AdmissibleParams}

    55	    (first second : Placement) (hopposite : first.IsOpposite second) :
    56	    ∃ equivalence : SixReg params setting.toStrategy.ιA setting.toStrategy.ιB ≃
    57	        setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side ×
    58	          (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side ×
    59	            (PauliRegister params × PauliRegister params)),
    60	      (∀ operator : Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace first.side),
    61	        reindexOp equivalence (heteroKron operator 1) = setting.place first operator) ∧
    62	      (∀ operator : Op (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side),
    63	        reindexOp equivalence (heteroKron 1 (heteroKron operator
    64	          (1 : Op (PauliRegister params × PauliRegister params)))) =

    35	def scalarWrongVariableMass {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

    37	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))

    39	  classical
    40	  exact ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g =>
    41	    (∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),
    42	      scalarPolynomial P g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
    43	        MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1) ∧

    48	/-- Exact placement and order transport for the common joint scalar sample.

    50	theorem placed_fiber_orderedIndicator {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    51	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) (reverse : Bool)
    52	    (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
    53	    orderedIndicator
    54	      (S.placedMeasurement p (S.pointMeasExp p.side (if reverse then .Z else .X) x))
    55	      (S.placedMeasurement p (S.pointMeasExp p.side (if reverse then .X else .Z) z))
    56	      (v 0) (v 1) a =
    57	    let y := fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v)
    58	    S.place p (∑ ab ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P =>
    59	        y.2.1 * ab.1 + y.2.2 * ab.2 = a),
    60	      if reverse then
    61	        (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z y.1.2).effect ab.2 *
    62	          (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X y.1.1).effect ab.1
    63	      else
    64	        (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X y.1.1).effect ab.1 *
    65	          (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z y.1.2).effect ab.2) := by
    66	  dsimp only
    67	  rw [S.place_finsetSum, Finset.sum_filter]
    68	  simp only [orderedIndicator, ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect]
    69	  cases reverse
    70	  · simp [fiberQuestionEquiv, ProjectiveSetting.place_mul]
    71	  · apply Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.prodComm (PauliScalar P) (PauliScalar P))
    72	    intro ab
    73	    simp [fiberQuestionEquiv, add_comm, ProjectiveSetting.place_mul]

    75	/-- Both wrong-variable classes are bounded in their appropriate actual

    82	theorem scalarWrongVariableMass_le_ordered_error {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

    84	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    85	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) (reverse : Bool) :
    86	    scalarWrongVariableMass S p1 R reverse ≤
    87	      2 * extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R reverse +
    88	        2 * (((P.m * P.d + P.m * P.d + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) := by
    89	  classical
    90	  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun g =>
    91	    (∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),
    92	      scalarPolynomial P g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
    93	        MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1) ∧
    94	    ¬ ∃ r, blockCoefficientPolynomial P g
    95	      (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 0 else 1) 1) reverse = MvPolynomial.C r)
    96	  let ψ := fun g => applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 (R.effect g)) S.psiHat
    97	  let X := fun x : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P => S.placedMeasurement p2
    98	    (S.pointMeasExp p2.side (if reverse then .Z else .X) x)
    99	  let Z := fun z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P => S.placedMeasurement p2
   100	    (S.pointMeasExp p2.side (if reverse then .X else .Z) z)
   101	  let A := fun (z x : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) g =>
   102	    applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X x) (Z z) (v 0) (v 1)
   103	      (extendedPolynomialRead P (fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v)) g)) (ψ g)
   104	  let B : ℝ := ((P.m * P.d + P.m * P.d + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q
   105	  have hmass : ∑ g, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
   106	    simpa only [ψ, ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect, S.psiHat_norm, one_pow] using
   107	      sum_projective_state_norm_sq (S.placedMeasurement p1 R)
   108	        (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p1 R hR) S.psiHat
   109	  have hnorm (g) (hg : g ∈ s) :
   110	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun z =>
   111	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
   112	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
   113	            ‖A z x v g‖ ^ 2))) ≤ B * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := by
   114	    obtain ⟨hlin, hnon⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hg).2
   115	    have hd := blockCoefficientPolynomial_degrees P g
   116	      (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 0 else 1) 1) reverse
   117	    have h := avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_nonconstant
   118	      (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 0 else 1) 1) reverse)
   119	      hnon hd.1 hd.2
   120	      (fun x z => MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   121	        (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g
   122	          (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 1 else 0) 1) reverse))) X Z
   123	      (fun x => S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p2 _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _))
   124	      (fun z => S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p2 _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _)) (ψ g)
   125	    have hcard : Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) = P.q :=
   126	      @FieldModel.card P.q P.model.toFieldModel
   127	    simpa only [A, scalarPolynomial_linear_read_fiber P g hlin, hcard, B] using h
   128	  have hnormsum :
   129	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun z =>
   130	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
   131	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
   132	            ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A z x v g‖ ^ 2))) ≤ B := by
   133	    simp_rw [avgOver_finset_sum]
   134	    calc
   135	      _ ≤ ∑ g ∈ s, B * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_le_sum hnorm
   136	      _ ≤ ∑ g, B * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 :=
   137	        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (by
   138	          intros; dsimp [B]; positivity)
   139	      _ = B := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hmass, mul_one]
   140	  have hfull :
   141	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun z =>
   142	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
   143	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
   144	            ∑ g, ‖ψ g - A z x v g‖ ^ 2))) =
   145	        extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R reverse := by
   146	    rw [← avgOver_uniform_prod (fun z x =>
   147	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
   148	        ∑ g, ‖ψ g - A z x v g‖ ^ 2))]
   149	    rw [← avgOver_uniform_prod
   150	      (fun zx : (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) =>
   151	        fun v => ∑ g, ‖ψ g - A zx.1 zx.2 v g‖ ^ 2)]
   152	    unfold extendedPolynomialOrderedError
   153	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse).symm]
   154	    apply avgOver_congr
   155	    rintro ⟨⟨z, x⟩, v⟩
   156	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   157	    intro g _
   158	    dsimp only [A, X, Z]
   159	    rw [placed_fiber_orderedIndicator]
   160	    dsimp only [ψ]
   161	    rw [placed_residual S p1 p2 hopposite]
   162	    rfl
   163	  have herror :
   164	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun z =>
   165	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
   166	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v =>
   167	            ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A z x v g‖ ^ 2))) ≤
   168	        extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R reverse := by
   169	    rw [← hfull]
   170	    apply avgOver_mono
   171	    intro z
   172	    apply avgOver_mono
   173	    intro x
   174	    apply avgOver_mono
   175	    intro v
   176	    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (by
   177	      intros; exact sq_nonneg _)
   178	  have h := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) _ _ fun z =>
   179	    avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) _ _ fun x =>
   180	      avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) _ _ fun v =>
   181	        sum_mass_le_residual_add_image s ψ (A z x v)
   182	  simp only [avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_add, avgOver_const_mul] at h
   183	  change scalarWrongVariableMass S p1 R reverse ≤ _ at h
   184	  change scalarWrongVariableMass S p1 R reverse ≤ _ + 2 * B

   196	theorem exists_rounded_polynomial_wrong_variable_mass :

   321	          extendedPolynomialOrderedError S .BB' .AB'' RB reverse ≤ 4 * eta + 8 * δQ) ∧
   322	        separatedPolynomialMass S .AA' RA ≤ 6 * (4 * eta + 8 * δQ) +
   323	          (((12 * P.m * P.d + 4 * P.d + 10 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) ∧
   324	        separatedPolynomialMass S .BB' RB ≤ 6 * (4 * eta + 8 * δQ) +
   325	          (((12 * P.m * P.d + 4 * P.d + 10 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) := by
   326	  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, h⟩ := exists_rounded_polynomial_ordered_estimates
   327	  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, ?_⟩
   328	  intro P ε δQ δL S points lines delta eta
   329	  obtain ⟨RA, RB, hRA, hRB, horder⟩ := h P ε δQ δL S points lines
   330	  refine ⟨RA, RB, hRA, hRB, horder, ?_, ?_⟩
   331	  · have hA := separatedPolynomialMass_le_ordered_errors S .AA' .BA'' (by trivial) RA hRA
   332	    have h0 := (horder false).1
   333	    have h1 := (horder true).1
   334	    linarith
   335	  · have hB := separatedPolynomialMass_le_ordered_errors S .BB' .AB'' (by trivial) RB hRB
   336	    have h0 := (horder false).2
   337	    have h1 := (horder true).2
   338	    linarith
   339	
   340	end ExtendedLineGame

     4	/-!
     5	# Scalar-nonlinear mass of the actual rounded measurements
     6	
     7	The full polynomial-outcome ordered estimate is composed with the concentration
     8	bound for scalar-nonlinear outcomes. Opposite placements commute; no symmetry of the
     9	player spaces is required. Projectivity retains the actual outcome masses.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	`eq:qld-g-42`, `eq:qld-g-prime`, and `eq:qld-g-prime-bound`, paper
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1283-1326`.
    15	This is only scalar-linearity concentration; the variable-separation estimates
    16	and retained overlaps are separate results.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    24	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus PolynomialImageBounds

    30	/-- Actual mass of outcomes outside `alpha*g1(x,z) + beta*g2(x,z)`. The
    31	coefficients may still depend on both base blocks. -/
    32	def scalarNonlinearMass {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    33	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
    34	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) : ℝ := by
    35	  classical
    36	  exact ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g => ¬ ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m))
    37	      (PauliScalar P), scalarPolynomial P g =
    38	        MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1),
    39	    ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p (R.effect g)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2
    40	
    41	private theorem placed_orderedIndicator {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    42	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement) (x : ExtendedPointQuestion P)
    43	    (a : PauliScalar P) :
    44	    orderedIndicator (S.placedMeasurement p (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X x.1.1))
    45	      (S.placedMeasurement p (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z x.1.2)) x.2.1 x.2.2 a =
    46	    S.place p (∑ ab ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P =>
    47	        x.2.1 * ab.1 + x.2.2 * ab.2 = a),
    48	      (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X x.1.1).effect ab.1 *
    49	        (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z x.1.2).effect ab.2) := by
    50	  rw [S.place_finsetSum, Finset.sum_filter]
    51	  simp only [orderedIndicator, ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
    52	    ProjectiveSetting.place_mul]
    53	
    54	/-- Opposite placements commute, identifying the residual on the actual
    55	projected state with the ordered-error residual. This supports both orders
    56	of `eq:qld-g-42/43` and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    57	theorem placed_residual {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    58	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
    59	    (R : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side)) (T : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p2.side)) :
    60	    applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 R) S.psiHat -
    61	      applyOperatorToState (S.place p2 T)
    62	        (applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 R) S.psiHat) =
    63	      applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 R * (1 - S.place p2 T)) S.psiHat := by
    64	  rw [← applyOperatorToState_mul, ← S.place_comm p1 p2 hopposite R T, mul_sub, mul_one]
    65	  simp only [applyOperatorToState, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
    66	
    67	/-- The scalar-nonlinear outcome mass is bounded by twice the actual full
    68	ordered error plus `2*((2m+2)d+1)/q`. All transports and degree bounds are
    69	derived internally from the actual singleton outcomes. This auxiliary applies
    70	to every opposite placement of a complete projective measurement. -/
    71	theorem scalarNonlinearMass_le_ordered_error {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    72	    (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
    73	    (R : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    74	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) :
    75	    scalarNonlinearMass S p1 R ≤ 2 * extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R false +
    76	      2 * (((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q := by
    77	  classical
    78	  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun g => ¬ ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m))
    79	      (PauliScalar P), scalarPolynomial P g =
    80	        MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
    81	  let ψ := fun g => applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 (R.effect g)) S.psiHat
    82	  let X := fun u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P => S.placedMeasurement p2
    83	    (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X (fun i => u ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inl i))))
    84	  let Z := fun u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P => S.placedMeasurement p2
    85	    (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z (fun i => u ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inr i))))
    86	  have hX : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (X u) := fun u =>
    87	    S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p2 _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _)
    88	  have hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u) := fun u =>
    89	    S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p2 _ (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective _ _ _)
    90	  have h := nonlinear_mass_le_ordered_error s (scalarPolynomial P)
    91	    (fun g hg => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hg).2) X Z hX hZ ψ
    92	  have hmass : ∑ g, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    93	    simpa only [ψ, ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect, S.psiHat_norm, one_pow] using
    94	      sum_projective_state_norm_sq (S.placedMeasurement p1 R)
    95	        (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p1 R hR) S.psiHat
    96	  have hdegree : (∑ g ∈ s,
    97	      (((scalarPolynomial P g).support.sup fun e =>
    98	          ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
    99	        max 1 (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree + 1 : ℕ) /
   100	          (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2) ≤
   101	      (((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q := by
   102	    have hcard : Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) = P.q :=
   103	      @FieldModel.card P.q P.model.toFieldModel
   104	    rw [hcard]
   105	    calc
   106	      _ ≤ ∑ g ∈ s, ((((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := by
   107	        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   108	        intro g _
   109	        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
   110	        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
   111	        exact_mod_cast scalarPolynomial_degree_term_le P g
   112	      _ ≤ ∑ g, ((((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 :=
   113	        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (by
   114	          intros; positivity)
   115	      _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hmass, mul_one]
   116	  let f := fun (u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) g =>
   117	    ‖ψ g - applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   118	      (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u)
   119	        (scalarPolynomial P g)))) (ψ g)‖ ^ 2
   120	  have hfull : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   121	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v => ∑ g, f u v g)) =
   122	        extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R false := by
   123	    rw [← avgOver_uniform_prod (fun u v => ∑ g, f u v g)]
   124	    unfold extendedPolynomialOrderedError
   125	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P).symm]
   126	    apply avgOver_congr
   127	    rintro ⟨u, v⟩
   128	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   129	    intro g _
   130	    dsimp only [f]
   131	    rw [scalarPolynomial_eval]
   132	    have hXZ : orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   133	        (extendedPolynomialRead P (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)) g) =
   134	        orderedIndicator
   135	          (S.placedMeasurement p2 (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X
   136	            (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)).1.1))
   137	          (S.placedMeasurement p2 (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z
   138	            (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)).1.2))
   139	          (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)).2.1
   140	          (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)).2.2
   141	          (extendedPolynomialRead P (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)) g) := by
   142	      simp [X, Z, scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply]
   143	    rw [hXZ, placed_orderedIndicator]
   144	    dsimp only [ψ]
   145	    rw [placed_residual S p1 p2 hopposite]
   146	    rfl
   147	  have herror : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P)) (fun u =>
   148	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s, f u v g)) ≤
   149	        extendedPolynomialOrderedError S p1 p2 R false := by
   150	    rw [← hfull]
   151	    apply avgOver_mono
   152	    intro u
   153	    apply avgOver_mono
   154	    intro v
   155	    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (by
   156	      intros; exact sq_nonneg _)
   157	  change scalarNonlinearMass S p1 R ≤ 2 * _ + 2 * _ at h
   158	  have hout := h.trans (add_le_add
   159	    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left herror (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
   160	    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdegree (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)))
   161	  simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using hout
   162	
   163	/-- Actual rounded measurements satisfy scalar-linearity concentration for both
   164	player placements, with all point, line, soundness, and rounding errors retained.
   165	The measurements are produced by `exists_rounded_polynomial_ordered_estimates`;
   166	neither an ordered estimate nor a mass bound is an assumption. Both ordered
   167	estimates remain available for the subsequent variable-separation argument.
   168	
   169	The directly indexed, completed-answer line witness is an explicit restriction
   170	of this auxiliary, as documented in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
   171	and `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`. This proves only the
   172	scalar-linearity calculation `eq:qld-g-prime-bound`, not `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   173	theorem exists_rounded_polynomial_scalar_mass :
   174	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
   175	      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε δQ δL : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
   176	        (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ) (_lines : ExtendedLinesWitness S points δL),
   177	      let delta := deltaLd a b
   178	        (directPassingErrorEnvelope (δQ + δL) ((P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q))
   179	        P.q (2 * P.m + 2) P.d 1
   180	      let eta := delta + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow delta (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
   181	        2 * Real.sqrt (2 * delta)
   182	      ∃ RA : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice),
   183	      ∃ RB : DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob),
   184	        Measurement.IsProjective RA ∧ Measurement.IsProjective RB ∧
   185	        (∀ reverse : Bool,
   186	          extendedPolynomialOrderedError S .AA' .BA'' RA reverse ≤ 4 * eta + 8 * δQ ∧
   187	          extendedPolynomialOrderedError S .BB' .AB'' RB reverse ≤ 4 * eta + 8 * δQ) ∧
   188	        scalarNonlinearMass S .AA' RA ≤ 2 * (4 * eta + 8 * δQ) +
   189	          2 * (((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q ∧
   190	        scalarNonlinearMass S .BB' RB ≤ 2 * (4 * eta + 8 * δQ) +
   191	          2 * (((2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / P.q := by
   192	  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, h⟩ := exists_rounded_polynomial_ordered_estimates
   193	  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, ?_⟩
   194	  intro P ε δQ δL S points lines delta eta
   195	  obtain ⟨RA, RB, hRA, hRB, horder⟩ := h P ε δQ δL S points lines
   196	  refine ⟨RA, RB, hRA, hRB, horder, ?_, ?_⟩
   197	  · exact (scalarNonlinearMass_le_ordered_error S .AA' .BA'' (by trivial) RA hRA).trans
   198	      (add_le_add
   199	        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (horder false).1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)) le_rfl)
   200	  · exact (scalarNonlinearMass_le_ordered_error S .BB' .AB'' (by trivial) RB hRB).trans
   201	      (add_le_add
   202	        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (horder false).2 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)) le_rfl)
   203	
   204	end ExtendedLineGame

1	import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Defs
     2	import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.Sandwich.Support
     3	
     4	/-!
     5	# Restricting and completing global polynomial-pair measurements
     6	
     7	The combining map embeds pairs of bounded individual-degree polynomials into
     8	extended polynomials. Restricting a measurement along this embedding produces a
     9	submeasurement whose missing operator is the sum of the noncombined effects.
    10	Relabeling those effects by one specified pair completes the measurement and
    11	preserves projectivity.
    12	
    13	These algebraic constructions do not establish the concentration estimate
    14	`eq:qld-g-non-separable` or the point consistency required by
    15	`exists_globalPairWitness`; those are separate quantitative obligations.
    16	
    17	## References
    18	
    19	- Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
    20	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1375-1404`,
    21	  `eq:qld-sgg-completeness` and the final completion paragraph.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    25	
    26	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder
    27	
    28	noncomputable section
    29	
    30	/-- Recover the two polynomial components by setting the unused block to zero
    31	and the scalar coordinates to `(1,0)` or `(0,1)`. This algebraic substitution
    32	is the left inverse implicit in the restriction to combined outcomes in
    33	`eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. Unlike evaluation as a
    34	polynomial function on a finite field, it does not require a degree bound. -/
    35	noncomputable def recoverCombinedPair {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ}
    36	    (polynomial : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * m + 2)) K) :
    37	    MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K :=
    38	  (MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C (fun index =>
    39	    match finCombineEquiv m index with
    40	    | .inl (.inl coordinate) => MvPolynomial.X coordinate
    41	    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
    42	    | .inr scalar => if scalar = 0 then 1 else 0) polynomial,
    43	   MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C (fun index =>
    44	    match finCombineEquiv m index with
    45	    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
    46	    | .inl (.inr coordinate) => MvPolynomial.X coordinate
    47	    | .inr scalar => if scalar = 1 then 1 else 0) polynomial)
    48	
    49	/-- Substitution recovers both components of a combined polynomial. This is
    50	formalization support for the relabeling in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper
    51	lines 1375--1380. -/
    52	@[simp] theorem recoverCombinedPair_combinePoly {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ}
    53	    (first second : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K) :
    54	    recoverCombinedPair (combinePoly first second) = (first, second) := by
    55	  simp [recoverCombinedPair, combinePoly, MvPolynomial.eval₂_rename,
    56	    embX, embZ, alphaVar, betaVar, Function.comp_def, MvPolynomial.eval₂_eta]
    57	
    58	/-- Distinct polynomial pairs label distinct combined outcomes. This justifies
    59	restricting a measurement on extended polynomials to pairs without duplicating
    60	an effect in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. -/
    61	theorem combinePoly_injective {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ} :
    62	    Function.Injective (fun pair : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K =>
    63	      combinePoly pair.1 pair.2) := by
    64	  exact (show Function.LeftInverse recoverCombinedPair
    65	    (fun pair : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K =>
    66	      combinePoly pair.1 pair.2) from fun pair =>
    67	        recoverCombinedPair_combinePoly pair.1 pair.2).injective
    68	
    69	/-- The bounded polynomial-pair embedding used to restrict the global
    70	measurement in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. The degree
    71	bound is inherited from `def:combine-map`; the two scalar coordinates have
    72	degree one, allowed by admissibility. -/
    73	noncomputable def combinedPolyEmbedding (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    74	    PolyPair P ↪ MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d where
    75	  toFun pair := ⟨combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1,
    76	    combinePoly_mem_polyFunc P.hd pair.1.2 pair.2.2⟩
    77	  inj' := by
    78	    intro first second heq
    79	    have hpoly : combinePoly first.1.1 first.2.1 = combinePoly second.1.1 second.2.1 :=
    80	      congrArg Subtype.val heq
    81	    have hpair : (first.1.1, first.2.1) = (second.1.1, second.2.1) :=
    82	      combinePoly_injective hpoly
    83	    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.fst hpair))
    84	      (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.snd hpair))
    85	
    86	/-- Evaluation of a combined outcome is the affine combination of its two
    87	components.  This is the pointwise algebraic identity used when transferring
    88	the global-pair measurement to the expanded point measurements in
    89	`lem:qld-4-7`, paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1364--1380`.
    90	It is a formalization-only consequence of `def:combine-map`; it does not assert
    91	any consistency or quantitative error estimate.
    92	-/
    93	theorem combinedPolyEmbedding_eval (P : AdmissibleParams)
    94	    (u : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → PauliScalar P) (pair : PolyPair P) :
    95	    MvPolynomial.eval u (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair).1 =
    96	      u (alphaVar P.m) * evalAt .X (projX u) pair +
    97	        u (betaVar P.m) * evalAt .Z (projZ u) pair := by
    98	  change MvPolynomial.eval u (combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1) = _
    99	  rw [combinePoly_eval]
   100	  rfl
   101	
   102	/-- Restrict an extended-polynomial measurement to combined outcomes, as in
   103	`eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. Injectivity of the combining
   104	map ensures that the retained effects sum to at most the identity. This
   105	construction does not assert the source's quantitative completeness bound. -/
   106	noncomputable def combinedPairSubmeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams)
   107	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   108	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   109	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier) :
   110	    Quantum.Submeasurement (PolyPair P) carrier where
   111	  effect pair := measurement.effect (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)
   112	  pos pair := measurement.pos _
   113	  sum_le_one := by
   114	    classical
   115	    rw [← Finset.sum_image (fun first _ second _ heq =>
   116	      (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective heq)]
   117	    exact (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
   118	      (fun outcome _ _ => measurement.pos outcome)).trans measurement.sum_le_one
   119	
   120	/-- Restricting to combined outcomes preserves projectivity, as asserted
   121	before `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. -/
   122	theorem combinedPairSubmeasurement_projective (P : AdmissibleParams)
   123	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   124	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   125	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   126	    (hprojective : Measurement.IsProjective measurement) :
   127	    ∀ pair, Quantum.IsProj ((combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).effect pair) := by
   128	  intro pair
   129	  exact hprojective (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)
   130	
   131	/-- The missing operator of the polynomial-pair submeasurement is exactly the
   132	sum of the effects outside the range of the combining map. This is the
   133	operator identity underlying `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380;
   134	the bound on its state mass is a separate obligation. -/
   135	theorem combinedPairSubmeasurement_missing (P : AdmissibleParams)
   136	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   137	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement

   175	        max 1 (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree + 1 ≤ (2 * P.m + 2) * P.d + 1 := by
   176	  have h := scalarPolynomial_degrees P g
   177	  have hc : ((scalarPolynomial P g).support.sup fun e =>
   178	      ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff e).totalDegree) ≤ 2 * P.m * P.d :=
   179	    Finset.sup_le fun e _ => h.1 e
   180	  have ho : max 1 (scalarPolynomial P g).totalDegree ≤ 2 * P.d :=
   181	    max_le (by have := P.hd; omega) h.2
   182	  calc
   183	    _ ≤ 2 * P.m * P.d + 2 * P.d + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.add_le_add hc ho) 1
   184	    _ = _ := by ring

   186	private theorem eval_sumRingEquiv {F A B : Type*} [CommSemiring F]
   187	    (p : MvPolynomial (A ⊕ B) F) (u : B → F) (v : A → F) :
   188	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u)
   189	      (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F A B p)) = MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim v u) p := by
   190	  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
   191	  | C a => simp
   192	  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
   193	  | mul_X p i hp => cases i <;> simp [hp]

   195	/-- Split the full joint uniform point into the base point and scalar point.
   196	This is one equivalence of sample spaces, not four marginal identifications. -/
   197	def scalarBaseQuestionEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   198	    ((Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) × (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) ≃
   199	      ExtendedPointQuestion P :=
   200	  (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).piCongrLeft fun _ => PauliScalar P).trans
   201	    (Equiv.sumPiEquivProdPi fun _ : Fin P.m ⊕ Fin P.m => PauliScalar P)).prodCongr
   202	      (finTwoArrowEquiv (PauliScalar P))

   204	private theorem scalarBaseQuestionEquiv_direct (P : AdmissibleParams)
   205	    (u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :
   206	    (directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv P).symm (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)) =
   207	      fun i => (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm
   208	        (Sum.elim v u (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m i)) := by
   209	  apply (directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv P).injective
   210	  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv_apply]
   211	  apply Prod.ext
   212	  · apply Prod.ext <;> funext i <;>
   213	      simp [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv, projX, projZ,
   214	        embX, embZ, directPointToPauli, Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply]
   215	  · apply Prod.ext <;>
   216	      simp [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv, alphaVar, betaVar,
   217	        directPointToPauli]

   219	/-- Evaluation of the nested polynomial is exactly the actual singleton readout,
   220	including the canonical field transport and all four coordinate blocks. -/
   221	theorem scalarPolynomial_eval (P : AdmissibleParams)
   222	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   223	    (u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :
   224	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (scalarPolynomial P g)) =
   225	      extendedPolynomialRead P (scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v)) g := by
   226	  rw [scalarPolynomial, eval_sumRingEquiv, MvPolynomial.eval_rename,
   227	    MvPolynomial.eval_map]
   228	  unfold extendedPolynomialRead evalDirectPolyTupleAt
   229	  rw [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv_direct]
   230	  have h := (MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom
   231	      (fun i => (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm
   232	        (Sum.elim v u (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m i))) (g (0 : Fin 1)).1).symm
   233	  change MvPolynomial.eval₂ (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom
   234	      (fun i => extendedDirectScalarEquiv P ((extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm
   235	        (Sum.elim v u (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m i)))) (g (0 : Fin 1)).1 = _ at h
   236	  simp only [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
   237	  exact h

   239	/-- Exact partial evaluation for either block order. This is the coefficient
   240	specialization used in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   241	theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_eval (P : AdmissibleParams)
   242	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool)
   243	    (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
   244	    MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   245	      (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse)) =
   246	    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => Sum.elim x z
   247	      (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   248	        (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) i))
   249	      ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a) := by
   250	  rw [blockCoefficientPolynomial, eval_sumRingEquiv, MvPolynomial.eval_rename]
   251	  rfl

   253	/-- Joint sample equivalence for the fiber calculation: the first input block
   254	is fixed and the second varies. Reversal exchanges both the point blocks and
   255	the scalar coefficients, so its ordered product is `ZX`. This supports the
   256	two orders in `eq:qld-g-42/43` and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   257	def fiberQuestionEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) (reverse : Bool) :
   258	    (((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) ×
   259	      (Fin 2 → PauliScalar P)) ≃ ExtendedPointQuestion P :=
   260	  (if reverse then Equiv.refl _ else Equiv.prodComm _ _).prodCongr
   261	    ((finTwoArrowEquiv (PauliScalar P)).trans
   262	      (if reverse then Equiv.prodComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _))
   263	
   264	/-- For a scalar-linear outcome, its actual readout equals the two specialized
   265	coefficient polynomials in the corresponding block and scalar order. This is
   266	an exact identity, with no field-size condition; support for `eq:qld-g-48`
   267	and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   268	theorem scalarPolynomial_linear_read_fiber (P : AdmissibleParams)
   269	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   270	    (hg : ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),
   271	      scalarPolynomial P g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   272	        MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   273	    (reverse : Bool) (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :
   274	    extendedPolynomialRead P (fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v)) g =
   275	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   276	        (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 1 else 0) 1)
   277	          reverse)) +
   278	      v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   279	        (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 0 else 1) 1)
   280	          reverse)) := by
   281	  obtain ⟨r, t, hg⟩ := hg
   282	  let u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P := fun i => Sum.elim x z
   283	    (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   284	      (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) i)
   285	  let v' : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P := if reverse then ![v 1, v 0] else v
   286	  have heq : scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v') =
   287	      fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v) := by
   288	    cases reverse <;> simp [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, fiberQuestionEquiv, u, v',
   289	      Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply]
   290	  rw [← heq, ← scalarPolynomial_eval, hg]
   291	  simp_rw [blockCoefficientPolynomial_eval, hg]
   292	  have h01 : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := by
   293	    intro h
   294	    simpa using congrArg (fun e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => e 0) h
   295	  simp only [map_add, map_mul, MvPolynomial.map_C, MvPolynomial.map_X,
   296	    MvPolynomial.eval_C, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
   297	  cases reverse <;>
   298	    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, MvPolynomial.coeff_add,
   299	      MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, h01, Ne.symm h01,
   300	      ↓reduceIte, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
   301	  · change MvPolynomial.eval u r * v 0 + MvPolynomial.eval u t * v 1 =
   302	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval u r + v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval u t
   303	    ring
   304	  · change MvPolynomial.eval u r * v 1 + MvPolynomial.eval u t * v 0 =
   305	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval u t + v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval u r
   306	    ring

   317	private theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_const {P : AdmissibleParams}
   318	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool)
   319	    (h : ∃ r, blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse = MvPolynomial.C r) :
   320	    ∃ r : Poly P, (scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a = MvPolynomial.rename
   321	      (fun i => ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   322	        (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)).symm (.inr i)) r.1 := by
   323	  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h
   324	  have hmem : r ∈ Preliminaries.polyFunc P.m (PauliScalar P) P.d := by
   325	    apply mem_polyFunc_of_degreeOf_le
   326	    intro i
   327	    apply MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff.mpr
   328	    intro b hb
   329	    have hcoeff :
   330	        ((blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse).coeff 0).coeff b ≠ 0 := by
   331	      simpa only [hr, MvPolynomial.coeff_C, ↓reduceIte] using MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hb
   332	    have hsupport : Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp.symm (0, b) ∈
   333	        (MvPolynomial.rename ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   334	          (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _))
   335	            ((scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a)).support := by
   336	      simpa only [blockCoefficientPolynomial, coeff_coeff_sumRingEquiv,
   337	        MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff] using hcoeff
   338	    simpa using blockCoefficientPolynomial_renamed_exponents P g a reverse _ hsupport (.inr i)
   339	  refine ⟨⟨r, hmem⟩, ?_⟩
   340	  let eqv := (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   341	    (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)
   342	  apply MvPolynomial.rename_injective eqv eqv.injective
   343	  apply (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv (PauliScalar P) (Fin P.m) (Fin P.m)).injective
   344	  change blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse = _
   345	  rw [hr, MvPolynomial.rename_rename]

   347	    funext i
   348	    exact eqv.apply_symm_apply _

   350	    MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _ (MvPolynomial.rename
   351	      (eqv ∘ (fun i => eqv.symm (.inr i))) r)

   354	private theorem scalarExpansion_combinePoly (P : AdmissibleParams)
   355	    (f h : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (PauliScalar P)) :
   356	    MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _
   357	      (MvPolynomial.rename (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m) (combinePoly f h)) =
   358	    MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.rename
   359	      (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inl i)) f) * MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2) +
   360	    MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.rename
   361	      (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inr i)) h) * MvPolynomial.X 1 := by
   362	  have hX : scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m ∘ embX P.m =
   363	      Sum.inr ∘ (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inl i)) := by
   364	    funext i
   365	    simp [scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv, embX]
   366	  have hZ : scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m ∘ embZ P.m =
   367	      Sum.inr ∘ (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inr i)) := by

   372	  rw [← MvPolynomial.rename_rename, ← MvPolynomial.rename_rename]
   373	  simp only [sumRingEquiv_rename_inr]
   374	  have ha : scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m (alphaVar P.m) = .inl 0 := by

   376	  have hb : scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m (betaVar P.m) = .inl 1 := by
   377	    simp [scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv, betaVar]
   378	  rw [ha, hb, MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv_X_inl, MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv_X_inl]

   381	/-- Scalar-linearity and independence of both wrong blocks place the actual
   382	outcome in the existing bounded `combinePoly` image. The two components have
   383	individual degree at most `d`, not merely total degree at most `md`.
   384	This identifies the separated image in `eq:qld-g-non-separable` with
   385	`def:combine-map`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   386	theorem exists_polyPair_of_scalar_separated (P : AdmissibleParams)
   387	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   388	    (hlin : ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),
   389	      scalarPolynomial P g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   390	        MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   391	    (hX : ∃ r, blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single 0 1) true = MvPolynomial.C r)
   392	    (hZ : ∃ r, blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single 1 1) false = MvPolynomial.C r) :
   393	    ∃ pair : PolyPair P,
   394	      MvPolynomial.map (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1 =
   395	        combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1 := by
   396	  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := blockCoefficientPolynomial_const g _ true hX
   397	  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := blockCoefficientPolynomial_const g _ false hZ

   399	  apply MvPolynomial.rename_injective (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
   400	    (scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m).injective
   401	  apply (MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv (PauliScalar P) (Fin 2) (Fin (2 * P.m))).injective
   402	  change scalarPolynomial P g = _
   403	  rw [scalarExpansion_combinePoly]
   404	  obtain ⟨r, t, hlin⟩ := hlin
   405	  have h01 : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := by

   408	  simp only [hlin, MvPolynomial.coeff_add, MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul,

   411	  change r = MvPolynomial.rename (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inl i)) f.1 at hf
   412	  change t = MvPolynomial.rename (fun i => (baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).symm (.inr i)) h.1 at hh

     4	/-!
     5	# Common exceptional fibers for polynomial coefficients
     6	
     7	A nonconstant polynomial in one block, with polynomial coefficients in a
     8	second block, has a nonzero coefficient at a nonconstant monomial. Its zero set controls
     9	all exceptional specializations simultaneously, independently of the outcome
    10	of a measurement. The weights may depend on the fixed block but not on the
    11	block being averaged.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1341-1358`,
    16	especially `eq:qld-g-2`; support for blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolynomialImageBounds
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    24	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	variable {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
    29	
    30	private theorem exists_nonconstant_coeff {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ}
    31	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r) :
    32	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
    33	  classical
    34	  by_contra! h
    35	  apply hp
    36	  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    37	  ext e
    38	  by_cases he : e = 0
    39	  · simp [he]
    40	  · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he, h e he]
    41	
    42	/-- A single coefficient defines the exceptional slices for every field
    43	outcome. Outside its zero set, every fiber has probability at most `D/q`;
    44	the exceptional set itself has probability at most `C/q`. Both degree
    45	conditions concern the displayed polynomial, not an assumed collision law.
    46	This is the common-set argument following `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting
    47	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    48	theorem exists_common_exceptional_coefficient {n k C D : ℕ}
    49	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    50	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    51	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D) :
    52	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 ∧
    53	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F))
    54	        (fun z => if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
    55	          (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F ∧
    56	      ∀ z : Fin k → F, MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) ≠ 0 → ∀ b : F,
    57	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    58	          (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    59	            then 1 else 0) ≤ (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F := by
    60	  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := exists_nonconstant_coeff p hp
    61	  refine ⟨e, he, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
    62	  · simpa using avg_eval_eq_le (p.coeff e) 0 hc (hcoeff e) (by simp)
    63	  · intro z hz b
    64	    have hne : MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p ≠ MvPolynomial.C b := by
    65	      intro h
    66	      apply hz
    67	      have h' := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff e) h
    68	      simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff_map, MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he] using h'
    69	    have hd : (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p).totalDegree ≤ D :=
    70	      (Finset.sup_mono (MvPolynomial.support_map_subset _ _)).trans hdegree
    71	    simpa using avg_eval_eq_le _ (MvPolynomial.C b) hne hd (by simp)
    72	
    73	/-- Summing all nonnegative outcome weights before averaging exceptional
    74	slices avoids an outcome-cardinality factor. The weights may depend on `z`
    75	and their sum is the same mass `M` at every `z`. This is the weighted fiber
    76	calculation in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    77	theorem avg_weighted_fiber_le {n k C D : ℕ}
    78	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    79	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    80	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D)
    81	    (w : (Fin k → F) → F → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    82	    (hw : ∀ z b, 0 ≤ w z b) (hsum : ∀ z, ∑ b, w z b = M) :
    83	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z => ∑ b : F,
    84	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    85	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    86	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤ ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    87	  classical
    88	  obtain ⟨e, _, _, hbad, hgood⟩ :=
    89	    exists_common_exceptional_coefficient p hp hcoeff hdegree
    90	  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by
    91	    rw [← hsum (fun _ => 0)]
    92	    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => hw _ b
    93	  have hpoint (z : Fin k → F) :
    94	      (∑ b : F, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    95	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    96	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤
    97	      (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
    98	        (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    99	    by_cases hz : MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0
   100	    · simp only [hz, if_true, one_mul]
   101	      apply le_trans (b := M)
   102	      · rw [← hsum z]
   103	        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   104	        intro b _
   105	        apply le_trans (b := 1 * w z b)
   106	        · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hw z b)
   107	          apply avgOver_uniform_le_const
   108	          intro x
   109	          split_ifs <;> norm_num
   110	        · rw [one_mul]
   111	      · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hM)
   112	    · simp only [hz, if_false, zero_mul, zero_add]
   113	      rw [← hsum z, Finset.mul_sum]
   114	      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ =>
   115	        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgood z hz b) (hw z b)
   116	  calc
   117	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   118	        (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
   119	          (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M) := avgOver_mono _ _ _ hpoint
   120	    _ ≤ (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M + (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
   121	      rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_mul_const, avgOver_uniform_const]
   122	      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbad hM) le_rfl
   123	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

   127	private theorem avg_diagonalIndicator_linear_le
   128	    (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   129	    (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   130	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   131	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t))) ≤
   132	      (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   133	        stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t * X.effect r * Z.effect t) := by
   134	  classical
   135	  let w (bc : F × F) : ℝ := stateQForm ψ
   136	    (Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2)
   137	  have hw (bc : F × F) : 0 ≤ w bc :=
   138	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).1 bc)
   139	  have hsum : ∑ bc, w bc = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   140	    rw [← stateQForm_one ψ, ← (pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).2,
   141	      stateQForm_finset_sum]
   142	    rfl
   143	  have hexpand (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   144	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) =
   145	      ∑ bc : F × F, (if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t
   146	        then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   147	    rw [diagonalIndicator, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   148	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   149	    intro bc _
   150	    split_ifs <;> simp [w, stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
   151	  have hcollision (bc : F × F) :
   152	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   153	        if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
   154	        if bc = (r, t) then 1 else (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
   155	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   156	    exact affine_collision_average bc (r, t)
   157	  simp_rw [hexpand, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const, hcollision]
   158	  calc
   159	    _ ≤ ∑ bc : F × F, ((Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ +
   160	        if bc = (r, t) then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   161	      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   162	      intro bc _
   163	      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hw bc)
   164	      split_ifs <;> simp
   165	    _ = _ := by
   166	      simp_rw [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   167	      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hsum]
   168	      simp [w]

   170	private theorem avg_orderedIndicator_linear_le
   171	    (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X)
   172	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   173	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   174	      ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1)
   175	        (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2) ≤
   176	      2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 + stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t) := by
   177	  have hexc : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   178	      (fun v => if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) =
   179	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   180	    change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   181	      (fun v => if ((finTwoArrowEquiv F) v).2 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) = _
   182	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   183	    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   184	    rw [avgOver_uniform_snd (fun β : F => if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0)]
   185	    simp [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
   186	  have hdrop : stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t * X.effect r * Z.effect t) ≤
   187	      stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t) := by
   188	    apply quadratic_form_mono
   189	    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, measurement_effect_hermitian, mul_one,
   190	      (hZ t).isIdempotentElem.eq] using
   191	      star_left_conjugate_le_conjugate (measurement_effect_le_one X r) (Z.effect t)
   192	  have havg := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ (fun v =>
   193	    le_trans (le_abs_self _) (abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le
   194	      X Z hX hZ (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t) ψ))
   195	  rw [avgOver_sub, hexc] at havg
   196	  have hdiag := avg_diagonalIndicator_linear_le X Z hZ r t ψ
   197	  linarith
   198	
   199	/-- The wrong-variable coefficient is concentrated only after the middle
   200	contraction has been removed. The outer measurement depends solely on the
   201	fixed block `z`; `X` depends solely on the varying block `x`. For the other
   202	class interchange `X,Z` and the two blocks. The vector is arbitrary and
   203	need not be normalized. This proves the local norm bound behind
   204	`eq:qld-g-prime-xpt-bound` and its reversed-order counterpart, supporting
   205	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   206	theorem avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_nonconstant {n k C D : ℕ}
   207	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
   208	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
   209	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D)
   210	    (r : (Fin n → F) → (Fin k → F) → F)
   211	    (X : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   212	    (Z : (Fin k → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   213	    (hX : ∀ x, Measurement.IsProjective (X x))
   214	    (hZ : ∀ z, Measurement.IsProjective (Z z)) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   215	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   216	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun x =>
   217	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   218	          ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X x) (Z z) (v 0) (v 1)
   219	            (v 0 * r x z + v 1 *
   220	              MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))) ψ‖ ^ 2))) ≤
   221	      ((C + D + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   222	  classical
   223	  let w (z : Fin k → F) (b : F) := stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect b)
   224	  have hsum (z : Fin k → F) : ∑ b, w z b = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   225	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, (Z z).sum_eq_one, stateQForm_one]
   226	  have hfiber := avg_weighted_fiber_le p hp hcoeff hdegree w (‖ψ‖ ^ 2)
   227	    (fun z b => stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((Z z).pos b)) hsum
   228	  have heval (z : Fin k → F) (x : Fin n → F) :
   229	      stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect
   230	        (MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))) =
   231	      ∑ b : F, (if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
   232	        then 1 else 0) * w z b := by
   233	    simp [w]
   234	  calc
   235	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   236	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun x =>
   237	          2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   238	          stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect
   239	            (MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))))) := by
   240	      apply avgOver_mono
   241	      intro z
   242	      apply avgOver_mono
   243	      intro x
   244	      exact avg_orderedIndicator_linear_le (X x) (Z z) (hX x) (hZ z) _ _ ψ
   245	    _ = 2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   246	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z => ∑ b : F,
   247	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   248	            (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
   249	              then 1 else 0) * w z b) := by
   250	      simp_rw [heval, avgOver_add, avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const]
   251	    _ ≤ 2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   252	        ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := add_le_add le_rfl hfiber
   253	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring
   254	
   255	end

     5	/-!
     6	# Indicator-weighted ordered projectors
     7	
     8	This module proves the local norm calculation in `eq:qld-g-prime`. The state
     9	vector is not assumed normalized: its squared norm controls the exceptional
    10	coefficient, so the estimate can be summed over all polynomial outcomes.
    11	The measurements act on an arbitrary finite space, which includes either
    12	player's placed expanded measurements.
    13	
    14	The coefficient-polynomial argument also bounds mass outside the scalar-linear
    15	image, with its actual ordered-correlation error displayed in the conclusion.
    16	These are auxiliary estimates, not the global polynomial-pair construction.
    17	The remaining block-separation and construction obligations are recorded in
    18	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex` and issue #513.
    19	
    20	Only the dependency chain needed for these estimates is exposed; supporting
    21	lemmas remain private.
    22	
    23	## References
    24	
    25	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1289-1326`,
    26	  especially `eq:qld-g-42`, `eq:qld-g-43`, and `eq:qld-g-prime`.
    27	-/

    43	/-- The ordered product selected by the linear field-answer check in
    44	`eq:qld-g-42`. This is an operator, not an asserted measurement effect. -/
    45	def orderedIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    46	  ∑ bc : F × F, if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    47	
    48	/-- The diagonal sandwich sum in `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
    49	def diagonalIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    50	  ∑ bc : F × F,
    51	    if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then
    52	      Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    53	
    54	/-- For a nonzero second coefficient, X orthogonality and cancellation in
    55	the field eliminate every off-diagonal term of the ordered Gram operator.
    56	This is the exact local algebra behind `eq:qld-g-prime`; no commutation of
    57	the X and Z measurements is assumed. -/
    58	private theorem orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    59	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    60	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a =
    61	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a := by
    62	  classical
    63	  unfold orderedIndicator diagonalIndicator
    64	  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    65	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun bc _ => ?_
    66	  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single bc]
    67	  · by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    68	    · simp only [if_pos h, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, measurement_effect_hermitian]
    69	      rw [mul_assoc (Z.effect bc.2), ← mul_assoc (X.effect bc.1),
    70	        (hX bc.1).isIdempotentElem.eq, ← mul_assoc]
    71	    · simp [h]
    72	  · intro bc' _ hne
    73	    by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    74	    · by_cases h' : α * bc'.1 + β * bc'.2 = a
    75	      · have hb : bc.1 ≠ bc'.1 := by
    76	          intro hb
    77	          have hc : bc.2 = bc'.2 := mul_left_cancel₀ hβ (by
    78	            apply add_left_cancel (a := α * bc.1)
    79	            simpa only [hb] using h.trans h'.symm)
    80	          exact hne (Prod.ext hb hc).symm
    81	        simp only [if_pos h, if_pos h', Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    82	          measurement_effect_hermitian]
    83	        calc
    84	          Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * (X.effect bc'.1 * Z.effect bc'.2) =
    85	              Z.effect bc.2 * (X.effect bc.1 * X.effect bc'.1) * Z.effect bc'.2 := by
    86	            simp only [mul_assoc]
    87	          _ = 0 := by rw [projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero X hX hb]; simp
    88	      · simp [h']
    89	    · simp [h]
    90	  · simp

    92	/-- The squared state norm of the ordered indicator equals its diagonal
    93	sandwich quadratic form when the second coefficient is nonzero. -/
    94	private theorem orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    95	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    96	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    97	    ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 =
    98	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) := by
    99	  rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq,
   100	    orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   101	  rfl

   103	/-- The diagonal indicator is a positive contraction, since it selects
   104	effects from the complete sandwich POVM. -/
   105	private theorem diagonalIndicator_bounds (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   106	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   107	    0 ≤ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ∧ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   108	  obtain ⟨hpos, hsum⟩ := pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ
   109	  change (∀ bc : F × F, 0 ≤ Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) at hpos
   110	  change (∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) = 1 at hsum
   111	  constructor
   112	  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun bc _ => by
   113	      split_ifs
   114	      · exact hpos bc
   115	      · exact le_refl 0
   116	  · calc
   117	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤
   118	          ∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 := by
   119	        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun bc _ => ?_
   120	        split_ifs
   121	        · exact le_refl _
   122	        · exact hpos bc
   123	      _ = 1 := hsum

   125	/-- At the exceptional coefficient zero, completeness of Z leaves a
   126	coarse-grained X projection. This includes zero first coefficient. -/
   127	private theorem orderedIndicator_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α a : F) :
   128	    orderedIndicator X Z α 0 a = (X.postprocess (fun b => α * b)).effect a := by
   129	  unfold orderedIndicator
   130	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
   131	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   132	  by_cases h : α * b = a
   133	  · simp only [zero_mul, add_zero, h, if_true]
   134	    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Z.sum_eq_one, mul_one]
   135	  · simp [h]

   137	/-- Every linear-answer ordered indicator is a contraction. For nonzero
   138	second coefficient this follows from the diagonal identity; at zero it
   139	follows from completeness and projective postprocessing. -/
   140	theorem orderedIndicator_gram_le_one (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   141	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   142	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   143	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   144	  · subst β
   145	    rw [orderedIndicator_zero, measurement_effect_hermitian,
   146	      (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective X hX (fun b => α * b) a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   147	    exact measurement_effect_le_one _ _
   148	  · rw [orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   149	    exact (diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a).2

   151	/-- The pointwise error in `eq:qld-g-prime` is supported on the zero second
   152	coefficient and bounded by the squared norm of the actual state vector. -/
   153	theorem abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   154	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   155	    (α β a : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   156	    |‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   157	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a)| ≤
   158	      if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
   159	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   160	  · rw [if_pos hβ]
   161	    have hA0 := sq_nonneg ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖
   162	    have hA1 : ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   163	      rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, ← stateQForm_one ψ]
   164	      exact quadratic_form_mono (orderedIndicator_gram_le_one X Z hX hZ α β a) ψ
   165	    have hD := diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a
   166	    have hD0 := stateQForm_nonneg ψ hD.1
   167	    have hD1 : stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   168	      rw [← stateQForm_one ψ]
   169	      exact quadratic_form_mono hD.2 ψ
   170	    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
   171	  · rw [if_neg hβ, orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ ψ]
   172	    simp

   174	/-- Completeness and projectivity preserve total squared state mass. This is
   175	the normalization used after summing `eq:qld-g-prime` over polynomial labels. -/
   176	theorem sum_projective_state_norm_sq {Γ : Type*} [Fintype Γ]
   177	    (S : Quantum.Measurement Γ ι) (hS : Measurement.IsProjective S)
   178	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   179	    ∑ g : Γ, ‖applyOperatorToState (S.effect g) ψ‖ ^ 2 = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   180	  simp_rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, measurement_effect_hermitian,
   181	    fun g => (hS g).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   182	  change (∑ g : Γ, stateQForm ψ (S.effect g)) = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2
   183	  rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, S.sum_eq_one, stateQForm_one]
   184	
   185	/-- A polynomial not of the form `alpha * u + beta * v` has a nonzero
   186	coefficient outside those two monomials. Applied over the ring of base-point
   187	polynomials, this chooses one coefficient independently of both measurement
   188	outcomes in the argument following `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
   189	private theorem exists_nonzero_nonlinear_coeff {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
   190	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R)
   191	    (hp : ¬ ∃ u v : R, p = MvPolynomial.C u * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   192	      MvPolynomial.C v * MvPolynomial.X 1) :
   193	    ∃ e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, e ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1 ∧ e ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 ∧
   194	      p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
   195	  classical
   196	  have h01 : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := by
   197	    intro h
   198	    simpa using congrArg (fun e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => e 0) h
   199	  by_contra! h
   200	  apply hp
   201	  refine ⟨p.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 1), p.coeff (Finsupp.single 1 1), ?_⟩
   202	  ext e
   203	  by_cases h0 : e = Finsupp.single 0 1
   204	  · subst e
   205	    simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, Ne.symm h01]
   206	  · by_cases h1 : e = Finsupp.single 1 1
   207	    · subst e
   208	      simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, h01]
   209	    · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, Ne.symm h0, Ne.symm h1,
   210	        h e h0 h1]

   212	omit [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] in
   213	/-- A nonzero specialized coefficient outside the scalar-linear monomials
   214	certifies nonzero difference from every `alpha * b + beta * c` simultaneously.
   215	This is the common good-base-point criterion needed before sandwich weighting. -/
   216	private theorem specialization_ne_linear_of_coeff {n : ℕ}
   217	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)
   218	    (he0 : e ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1) (he1 : e ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1)
   219	    (u : Fin n → F) (hu : MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) ≠ 0) (b c : F) :
   220	    MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p ≠
   221	      MvPolynomial.C b * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 := by

   223	  apply hu

   231	    (hne : p ≠ r) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ D) (hr : r.totalDegree ≤ D) :

   233	      (fun u => if MvPolynomial.eval u p = MvPolynomial.eval u r then 1 else 0) ≤
   234	      (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F := by
   235	  have hsz := Preliminaries.schwartzZippel_totalDegree hne hp hr
   236	  calc
   237	    _ = (Preliminaries.polynomialAgreementProbability n F p r : ℝ) := by

   239	        Preliminaries.polynomialAgreementProbability, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

   243	/-- On every base point where the selected coefficient remains nonzero,

   246	private theorem avg_specialization_eq_linear_le_of_coeff {n : ℕ}
   247	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F)) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)

   260	    · exact (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _).trans (by simp)
   261	    · exact (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _).trans (by simp)

   266	/-- The first polynomial-image estimate for the diagonal sandwich, with
   267	explicit degrees of the scalar polynomial and its base-point coefficients.
   268	A single nonzero nonlinear coefficient supplies a common exceptional set for

   272	private theorem avg_diagonalIndicator_le_of_not_linear {n : ℕ}
   273	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))
   274	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r s : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F,
   275	      p = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C s * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   276	    (X Z : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   277	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   278	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   279	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   280	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   281	          (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p))))) ≤
   282	      ((p.support.sup fun e => (p.coeff e).totalDegree) + max 1 p.totalDegree : ℕ) /
   283	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   284	  classical
   285	  obtain ⟨e, he0, he1, he⟩ := exists_nonzero_nonlinear_coeff p hp
   286	  let D : ℕ := p.support.sup fun e => (p.coeff e).totalDegree
   287	  let E : ℝ := (max 1 p.totalDegree : ℕ) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ)

   290	  let f (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) : F :=
   291	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p)

   293	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement (X u) (Z u) (hZ u)).1 bc)

   295	    rw [← stateQForm_one ψ,
   296	      ← (pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement (X u) (Z u) (hZ u)).2, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   297	    rfl
   298	  have hexpand (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   299	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v)) =
   300	        ∑ bc : F × F, (if f u v = v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 then 1 else 0) * w u bc := by
   301	    rw [diagonalIndicator, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   302	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun bc _ => ?_
   303	    by_cases h : f u v = v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2
   304	    · simp [h, w]
   305	    · simp [Ne.symm h, h, stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
   306	  have hgood (u : Fin n → F) (hu : MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) ≠ 0) :
   307	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   308	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v))) ≤
   309	        E * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   310	    simp_rw [hexpand, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const]
   311	    rw [← hsum u, Finset.mul_sum]
   312	    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun bc _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
   313	      (avg_specialization_eq_linear_le_of_coeff p e he0 he1 u hu bc.1 bc.2) (hw u bc)
   314	  have hpoint (u : Fin n → F) :
   315	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   316	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v))) ≤
   317	        (if MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 + E * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   318	    by_cases hu : MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) = 0
   319	    · simp only [hu, if_true, one_mul]
   320	      apply le_trans (b := ‖ψ‖ ^ 2)
   321	      · apply avgOver_uniform_le_const
   322	        intro v
   323	        rw [← stateQForm_one ψ]
   324	        exact quadratic_form_mono (diagonalIndicator_bounds (X u) (Z u) (hZ u) _ _ _).2 ψ
   325	      · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (sq_nonneg _))
   326	    · simpa only [hu, if_false, zero_mul, zero_add] using hgood u hu
   327	  have hbad : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   328	      (fun u => if MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
   329	        (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F := by
   330	    simpa using avg_eval_eq_le (p.coeff e) 0 he
   331	      (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (p.coeff j).totalDegree)
   332	        (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr he)) (by simp)
   333	  calc
   334	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   335	        (if MvPolynomial.eval u (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 + E * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2) :=
   336	      avgOver_mono _ _ _ hpoint
   337	    _ ≤ (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 + E * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   338	      rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_mul_const, avgOver_uniform_const]
   339	      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbad (sq_nonneg _)) le_rfl
   340	    _ = _ := by dsimp [D, E]; push_cast; ring
