   342	/-- Adding the genuinely uniform zero-coefficient contribution gives the
   343	ordered-projector estimate for a polynomial outside the scalar-linear image.
   344	The right side retains the squared norm of the unnormalized state. -/
   345	private theorem avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear {n : ℕ}
   346	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))
   347	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r s : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F,
   348	      p = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C s * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   349	    (X Z : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   350	    (hX : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (X u))
   351	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   352	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   353	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   354	        ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   355	          (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p))) ψ‖ ^ 2)) ≤
   356	      ((p.support.sup fun e => (p.coeff e).totalDegree) + max 1 p.totalDegree + 1 : ℕ) /
   357	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   358	  let f (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) : F :=
   359	    MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) p)
   360	  have hexc : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   361	      (fun v => if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) =
   362	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   363	    change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   364	      (fun v => if ((finTwoArrowEquiv F) v).2 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) = _
   365	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   366	    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   367	    rw [avgOver_uniform_snd (fun β : F => if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0)]
   368	    simp [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
   369	  calc
   370	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   371	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   372	          stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v)) +
   373	            (if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0))) := by
   374	      apply avgOver_mono
   375	      intro u
   376	      apply avgOver_mono
   377	      intro v
   378	      have habs := abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le
   379	        (X u) (Z u) (hX u) (hZ u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v) ψ
   380	      have hle := le_trans (le_abs_self _) habs
   381	      linarith
   382	    _ = avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   383	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   384	          stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1) (f u v)))) +
   385	            (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   386	      simp_rw [avgOver_add, hexc, avgOver_uniform_const]
   387	    _ ≤ ((p.support.sup fun e => (p.coeff e).totalDegree) + max 1 p.totalDegree : ℕ) /
   388	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 + (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 :=
   389	      add_le_add (avg_diagonalIndicator_le_of_not_linear p hp X Z hZ ψ) le_rfl
   390	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

   392	/-- The ordered polynomial estimate sums over any specified set of polynomial
   393	labels outside the scalar-linear image. Each label is weighted by its actual
   394	state mass; the estimate never replaces a sum by the number of labels. -/
   395	private theorem avg_sum_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear {n : ℕ} {Γ : Type*}
   396	    (s : Finset Γ) (p : Γ → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))
   397	    (hp : ∀ g ∈ s, ¬ ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F,
   398	      p g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   399	    (X Z : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   400	    (hX : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (X u))
   401	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : Γ → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   402	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   403	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s,
   404	        ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   405	          (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (p g)))) (ψ g)‖ ^ 2)) ≤
   406	      ∑ g ∈ s,
   407	        (((p g).support.sup fun e => ((p g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
   408	          max 1 (p g).totalDegree + 1 : ℕ) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := by
   409	  simp_rw [avgOver_finset_sum]
   410	  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun g hg =>
   411	    avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear (p g) (hp g hg) X Z hX hZ (ψ g)
   412	
   413	omit [DecidableEq ι] in
   414	/-- The squared-norm triangle inequality retains each outcome's state vector.
   415	This norm-to-residual step is shared with the
   416	wrong-variable argument in `eq:qld-g-prime-xpt-bound`; support for blueprint
   417	`lem:qld-4-7`. No normalization is assumed. -/
   418	theorem sum_mass_le_residual_add_image {Γ : Type*} (s : Finset Γ)
   419	    (ψ A : Γ → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   420	    ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤
   421	      2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A g‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A g‖ ^ 2 := by
   422	  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   423	  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun g _ => ?_
   424	  have htriangle := norm_add_le (ψ g - A g) (A g)
   425	  rw [sub_add_cancel] at htriangle
   426	  have hsquare := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) htriangle 2
   427	  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖ψ g - A g‖ - ‖A g‖)]
   428	
   429	/-- Scalar-linearity concentration with the actual ordered-correlation error
   430	displayed in the conclusion. Combining this inequality with `eq:qld-g-42`
   431	requires deriving that correlation from the source measurements; no such
   432	estimate is an input to this auxiliary theorem. -/
   433	theorem nonlinear_mass_le_ordered_error {n : ℕ} {Γ : Type*}
   434	    (s : Finset Γ) (p : Γ → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) F))
   435	    (hp : ∀ g ∈ s, ¬ ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin n) F,
   436	      p g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   437	    (X Z : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   438	    (hX : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (X u))
   439	    (hZ : ∀ u, Measurement.IsProjective (Z u)) (ψ : Γ → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   440	    ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤
   441	      2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun u =>
   442	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s,
   443	          ‖ψ g - applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   444	            (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (p g)))) (ψ g)‖ ^ 2)) +
   445	      2 * ∑ g ∈ s,
   446	        (((p g).support.sup fun e => ((p g).coeff e).totalDegree) +
   447	          max 1 (p g).totalDegree + 1 : ℕ) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ) * ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 := by
   448	  let A (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) (g : Γ) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι :=
   449	    applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X u) (Z u) (v 0) (v 1)
   450	      (MvPolynomial.eval v (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval u) (p g)))) (ψ g)
   451	  have hpoint (u : Fin n → F) (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   452	      ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤
   453	        2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A u v g‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A u v g‖ ^ 2 :=
   454	    sum_mass_le_residual_add_image s ψ (A u v)
   455	  have havg := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) _ _ fun u =>
   456	    avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ (hpoint u)
   457	  simp only [avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_add, avgOver_const_mul] at havg
   458	  have hnorm := avg_sum_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_not_linear s p hp X Z hX hZ ψ
   459	  change ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   460	    (fun u => avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   461	      (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s, ‖ψ g - A u v g‖ ^ 2)) + _
   462	  change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   463	    (fun u => avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   464	      (fun v => ∑ g ∈ s, ‖A u v g‖ ^ 2)) ≤ _ at hnorm
   465	  linarith

     3	/-!
     4	# Ordered products selected by a global projective measurement
     5	
     6	The point comparison of a projective measurement can be refined to its original
     7	outcomes and composed with the two combined-point ordered-product estimates.
     8	All bounds are on the actual expanded state and retain the complete outcome sum.
     9	
    10	## References
    11	
    12	`eq:qld-g-42` and `eq:qld-g-43`, paper
    13	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1283-1300`.
    14	These are auxiliary estimates for issue #513, not the global-pair constructor.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    18	
    19	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    20	
    21	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    22	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
    23	
    24	noncomputable section
    25	
    26	/-- Projective refinement followed by two operator comparisons. If the evaluated
    27	measurement has consistency defect at most `eta` with `B`, and `B` is within
    28	`deltaSelf` of `A`, which is within `deltaOrder` of `T`, the full outcome sum
    29	for `R - R T` is at most `4 eta + 4 deltaSelf + 4 deltaOrder`.
    30	This is the quantitative insertion calculation in `eq:qld-g-42/43`; `T` need
    31	not be a measurement, so it applies to either ordered product. -/
    32	theorem projective_refinement_ordered_dist_le {X Γ α ι : Type*}
    33	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    34	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    35	    (μ : Distribution X) (R : Measurement Γ ι) (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R)
    36	    (ev : X → Γ → α) (A B : X → Measurement α ι) (T : X → α → Op ι)
    37	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (eta deltaSelf deltaOrder : ℝ)
    38	    (hpoint : consistencyDefect μ
    39	      (fun x a => (R.postprocess (ev x)).effect a) (fun x a => (B x).effect a) ψ ≤ eta)
    40	    (hself : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
    41	      (fun x a => (A x).effect a) ψ ≤ deltaSelf)
    42	    (horder : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (A x).effect a) T ψ ≤ deltaOrder) :
    43	    opFamilyDistSq μ (fun _ g => R.effect g)
    44	      (fun x g => R.effect g * T x (ev x g)) ψ ≤
    45	        4 * eta + 4 * deltaSelf + 4 * deltaOrder := by
    46	  have hlift (U V : X → α → Op ι) :
    47	      opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x g => R.effect g * U x (ev x g))
    48	        (fun x g => R.effect g * V x (ev x g)) ψ ≤ opFamilyDistSq μ U V ψ := by
    49	    unfold opFamilyDistSq
    50	    apply avgOver_mono
    51	    intro x
    52	    simpa only [mul_sub] using sum_norm_mul_funIndexed_apply_le (ev x) R.effect
    53	      (fun a => U x a - V x a) ψ (measurement_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one R)
    54	  have hinsert : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun _ g => R.effect g)
    55	      (fun x g => R.effect g * (B x).effect (ev x g)) ψ ≤ 2 * eta := by
    56	    have h := hlift (fun x a => (R.postprocess (ev x)).effect a)
    57	      (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
    58	    simp only [effect_mul_postprocess_effect_self R hR] at h
    59	    exact h.trans ((opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect μ
    60	      (fun x => R.postprocess (ev x)) B ψ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoint
    61	        (by norm_num)))
    62	  have htail := (hlift (fun x a => (B x).effect a) T).trans
    63	    (opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le μ (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
    64	      (fun x a => (A x).effect a) T ψ deltaSelf deltaOrder hself horder)

    80	witness or concentration estimate is assumed. -/

    83	    {Γ : Type*} [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    84	    (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
    85	    (R : Measurement Γ (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    86	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) (ev : ExtendedPointQuestion P → Γ → PauliScalar P)
    87	    (eta : ℝ)
    88	    (hpoint : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
    89	      (fun x a => S.place p1 ((R.postprocess (ev x)).effect a))
    90	      (fun x a => S.place p2
    91	        ((points.extendedQ p2.side x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤ eta) :
    92	    (opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
    93	      (fun _ g => S.place p1 (R.effect g))
    94	      (fun x g => S.place p1 (R.effect g) * S.place p2
    95	        (∑ ab ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P =>
    96	            x.2.1 * ab.1 + x.2.2 * ab.2 = ev x g),
    97	          (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X x.1.1).effect ab.1 *
    98	            (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z x.1.2).effect ab.2)) S.psiHat ≤
    99	        4 * eta + 8 * δQ) ∧
   100	    (opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
   101	      (fun _ g => S.place p1 (R.effect g))
   102	      (fun x g => S.place p1 (R.effect g) * S.place p2
   103	        (∑ ab ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P =>

   106	            (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X x.1.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat ≤

   109	  let A (x : ExtendedPointQuestion P) := S.placedMeasurement p1

   111	  let B (x : ExtendedPointQuestion P) := S.placedMeasurement p2

   129	      show 4 * eta + 4 * δQ + 4 * δQ = 4 * eta + 8 * δQ by ring] using h
   130	  · have h := hbound _ S.psiHat eta δQ δQ hpoint' hself
   131	      ((extendedQ_spec points).2.2.2 p1 p2 hopposite)
   132	    simpa only [ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
   133	      show 4 * eta + 4 * δQ + 4 * δQ = 4 * eta + 8 * δQ by ring] using h

    38	private theorem wrong_ordered_gram (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    39	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (r α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    40	    let T := (1 - X.effect r) * orderedIndicator X Z α β a
    41	    Tᴴ * T = ∑ bc : F × F,
    42	      if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a ∧ bc.1 ≠ r then
    43	        Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0 := by
    44	  classical
    45	  have hexpand : (1 - X.effect r) * orderedIndicator X Z α β a =
    46	      ∑ bc : F × F, if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a ∧ bc.1 ≠ r then
    47	        X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0 := by
    48	    rw [orderedIndicator, Finset.mul_sum]
    49	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    50	    intro bc _
    51	    by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    52	    · simp only [h, if_true, true_and, ← mul_assoc, wrong_mul_effect X hX]
    53	      split_ifs <;> simp_all
    54	    · simp [h]
    55	  dsimp only

    57	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun bc _ => ?_
    58	  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single bc]

    60	    · simp only [if_pos h, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, measurement_effect_hermitian]

    62	        (hX bc.1).isIdempotentElem.eq, ← mul_assoc]
    63	    · simp [h]
    64	  · intro bc' _ hne

    66	    · by_cases h' : α * bc'.1 + β * bc'.2 = a ∧ bc'.1 ≠ r
    67	      · have hb : bc.1 ≠ bc'.1 := by
    68	          intro hb
    69	          have hc : bc.2 = bc'.2 := mul_left_cancel₀ hβ (by
    70	            apply add_left_cancel (a := α * bc.1)

    88	theorem avg_wrong_ordered_norm_sq_le (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)

    90	    (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :

    92	      ‖applyOperatorToState ((1 - X.effect r) *
    93	        orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2) ≤
    94	      2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
    95	  classical
    96	  let w (bc : F × F) := stateQForm ψ
    97	    (Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2)
    98	  have hw (bc : F × F) : 0 ≤ w bc :=
    99	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).1 bc)

   101	    rw [← stateQForm_one ψ, ← (pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).2,
   102	      stateQForm_finset_sum]
   103	    rfl
   104	  have hpoint (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   105	      ‖applyOperatorToState ((1 - X.effect r) *
   106	        orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   107	      (if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) + ∑ bc : F × F,
   108	        (if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t ∧ bc.1 ≠ r
   109	          then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   110	    by_cases hv : v 1 = 0
   111	    · rw [if_pos hv]
   112	      apply le_trans (b := ‖ψ‖ ^ 2)
   113	      · apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
   114	        rw [applyOperatorToState_mul]

   116	          (MagicSquareRigidity.conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (hX r).one_sub) _).trans

   118	            (orderedIndicator_gram_le_one X Z hX hZ _ _ _) ψ)

   120	          mul_nonneg (by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (hw bc))
   121	    · rw [if_neg hv, zero_add, MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq]

   126	      intro bc _

   133	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   134	    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   135	    rw [avgOver_uniform_snd (fun β : F => if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0)]
   136	    simp [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]

   141	    by_cases hb : bc.1 = r

   165	          (orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2) +
   166	      4 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by

   168	      ‖applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤

   170	          (orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2 +

   172	          orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
